articleTitle: Research on Multi-source Data Fusion and Mining Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To solve the problem of massive multi-source data under the background of multi-sensor big data, a data fusion method which is easy to realize is used to fuse and mine the massive big data, and the difference between the fusion data and the real data is used as the stability judgment method. Compared with the measurement errors of single sensor and average estimation, it is proved that the heterogeneous sensor using weighted least square data fusion has higher measurement accuracy. The numerical examples are consistent with the theoretical derivation, which further verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method and improves the accuracy and mining effect of big data fusion.

articleTitle: A fast parameter estimation method for multicomponent LFM signal based on FRFT
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low search efficiency of traditional methods, this paper proposes a method to quickly and accurately estimate the parameters of multi-component linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal. Using the rotation equivalent relationship between the fractional Fourier transform (FRFT) and the Wigner distribution (WD), the calculation method of the optimal rotation angle of the LFM signal in the FRFT is deduced. Considering the problem that mutual interference between multi-component signals affects the estimation accuracy, an efficient search method is proposed to improve the estimation accuracy under the condition of less calculation amount. The simulation results show that this method can achieve fast and accurate estimation of multi-component LFM signal parameters.

articleTitle: A NLOS Detection Method Based on Machine Learning in UWB Indoor Location System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, location technology divides into outdoor location technology and indoor location technology. Comparing with other indoor location methods, ultra-wide band (UWB)indoor location technology has the advantages of strong anti-multipath interference ability and signal penetration ability. But, when this method faces large obstacles or metal obstacles, non line of sight (NLOS) will still occur. Indoor location system is a part of our project "Home Care System for The Elderly". The NLOS of Indoor location system reduces the reliability of "Home Care System for The Elderly". In order to improve the accuracy of location and efficiency of operation, an NLOS detection method based on k-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm is proposed. This algorithm modeled the training samples to find the K value with the highest recognition accuracy. The experimental results show that The NLOS detection accuracy of this method is 78% in the simulated apartment scene. With the same number of samples, the accuracy of the widely used Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) algorithm is 67%. The experimental results show that KNN algorithm is more suitable for "Home Care System for The Elderly" for it can keep high accuracy with less requirement for the number of samples than CNN.

articleTitle: TDOA Positioning Method Based on Taylor Series Expansion Based on Cuckoo Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low accuracy and large computation in traditional locating methods, an uWB locating method based on Taylor series expansion TDOA of cuckoo search algorithm is proposed. It is to substitute the nonlinear equation established by TDOA positioning measurement value into the initial value obtained by cuckoo search algorithm. This method utilizes the powerful maximum value search ability of Cuckoo algorithm to provide initial value for Taylor series expansion algorithm, which solves the problem that Taylor series expansion algorithm is sensitive to initial value and has good convergence characteristics. According to the simulation results, the TDOA positioning algorithm based on The Taylor series expansion of cuckoo search algorithm has a significant improvement in positioning accuracy compared with the common Chan-Taylor algorithm, and can obtain more accurate positioning results without increasing the system hardware cost.

articleTitle: Research on EEG signal preprocessing based on ICA fusion EMD
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The EEG signal is a random signal with a very complicated mechanism and very faint, and it is very susceptible to interference from electrooculogram artifact signals. This paper proposed an ICA-EMD EEG signal processing algorithm based on the fusion of independent component analysis (ICA) and empirical mode decomposition (EMD), which can remove noisy artifacts from EEG signals with high accuracy. This method firstly decomposes the multichannel EEG signal into statistically independent components by independent component analysis (ICA), and then using EMD filtering achieve the elimination of physiological artifacts of single-component EEG. the experiments show that the ICA-EMD algorithm can effectively retain the neural information in the artifacts and the brain electrical activity signals outside the artifact frequency band, therefore it avoids the loss of important brain electrical signals.

articleTitle: Research on Human Abnormal Behavior Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to make full use of the effective information in the video and improve the recognition rate of abnormal human behavior in complex scenes, we use a mixed Gaussian model to detect clear foreground moving target contours and perform Gaussian filtering on them to remove the effects of noise in the scene . By calculating the center point of the foreground pixel, and drawing a bounding box based on this, the key area of human motion in the video is extracted. Then we use the Farneback dense optical flow algorithm to obtain spatiotemporal information. By combining CNN and LSTM, a CNN-LSTM hybrid two-stream network model based on the Dropout mechanism is established., input the original image and the superimposed optical flow image of the key area of the video sequence motion to learn the dynamic and static features and timing information in the spatiotemporal information. The weighted fusion method is used to perform weighted calculation on the Softmax output of the two-way network to obtain results. The tresults show that the accuracy of the behavior classification reached 91.2%, and the recognition rate of abnormal behavior was 92%. Compared with the three models in the article, the improvement was 6% 8.3%, 3.4%.

articleTitle: Design of Ultrasonic Testing System for Defects of Composite Material Bonding Structure Based on Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Ultrasonic testing of composite material bonding structures has always been an important research topic. Existing testing methods mainly rely on the experience of operators to judge. Because the signal-to-noise ratio of ultrasonic signals of composite material bonding structures is very low, resulting the accuracy of the judgment is difficult to guarantee, and the degree of automation is very low. In this paper, the deep neural network was introduced into the discriminating of the ultrasonic inspection results to realize the automatic ultrasonic inspection of the bonding structure, and the hardware and software design of the system were completed. The design scheme proposed in this paper can provide a useful reference for the intelligentization and automation of ultrasonic testing.

articleTitle: The Research on Optimization Strategy of College English Teaching Mode Based on 5G Technology and Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitations of the current college English teaching mode in China, and to expand the service scope of 5G technology and artificial intelligence technology, this paper proposes an optimization strategy of English teaching mode in colleges and universities based on 5G technology and artificial intelligence technology. This optimization strategy breaks the traditional college English teaching mode in China, and introduces 5G technology and artificial intelligence technology, which greatly improves the intelligence of English classroom in colleges and universities. At the same time, the optimization strategy can also make 5G technology and artificial intelligence technology skillfully combine, which can improve the quality of English teaching in colleges and universities from many aspects, and comprehensively and systematically realize the teaching concept of "teach students according to their aptitude". The results show that the optimization strategy can not only overcome the limitations of English model in China in colleges and universities , but also improve the service scope of 5G technology and artificial intelligence technology, so as to improve students' English listening, speaking, reading and writing ability in multiple dimensions in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of rolling bearing based on generalized S-transform and dropout CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of feature extraction in the field of fault diagnosis, such as insufficient feature extraction and too complex classifier training, this paper takes rolling bearing, the key component of mechanical transmission device, as an example, and proposes to combine the feature extraction based on time-frequency analysis of generalized S-transform with dropout CNN to realize the fault detection of rolling bearing. In the diagnosis model, the time-frequency map of the original bearing data is obtained by the generalized S-transform, then the secondary feature is extracted by convolution neural network, and then the fault is classified by the classifier, so as to carry out the fault diagnosis of rolling bearing. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the diagnosis model can reach 99.6%, and the extracted features are highly differentiated. Compared with support vector machine (SVM) and convolutional neural network (CNN), this model has higher diagnostic accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Consensus Analysis of UAV Swarm Cooperative Situation Awareness
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: UAV swarm cooperative situation awareness (SA) and situation sharing is the basis of swarm cooperative decision and control. Swarm cooperative SA consensus is an important factor affecting swarm consistent decision-making. The related studies of consensus analysis do not consider the levels of SA and the uncertainty of situation information carefully, which is not very suitable for complex and antagonistic mission environments. Combined with the Endsley’s SA three-level model, this paper further proposes UAV swarm cooperative SA consensus three-level model, i.e. situation perception consensus, situation comprehension consensus and situation prediction consensus. The definitions and relationships of the SA consensus three-level model are carefully clarified and analysed. Then, the calculation methods of situation perception consensus and situation prediction consensus are described. The reaching process of situation comprehension consensus with a new feedback mechanism is proposed. A case study demonstrates the reaching process of situation comprehension consensus with the proposed feedback mechanism is efficient.

articleTitle: Research on target tracking method of sports video based on multi-template matching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The video tracking method based on single template matching is affected by the shape and transformation of single template, resulting in large tracking error and poor tracking effect. In this paper, a method of object tracking in sports video based on multi template matching is proposed. After preprocessing the video image, the background difference is used to detect the target in the video. Based on the selected benchmark template, the matching template is generated by multi-level geometric transformation and the template updating strategy is formulated. Extract the features of the template and image, and complete the tracking of sports video target by calculating the matching degree between multiple templates and image features. Through the contrast experiment, it is proved that the multi template matching tracking method has the advantages of short tracking time, high precision and better tracking effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Blockchain Technology in Accounting Information System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems existing in the traditional accounting information system, and to improve the application efficiency of the blockchain technology and the working efficiency of the accounting information system, this paper puts forward a method of constructing the application system of the accounting information system based on the blockchain technology. This construction method combines block chain technology scientifically and organically, and gives full play to the advantages of block chain technology, such as decentralization and data in-variance. Based on this, the construction method also studies and analyzes the problems existing in the current accounting information system, such as data quality, data security and so on, and analyzes the unfavorable factors that affect the current accounting information system, for example, hacker attacks, data theft and so on. The research results show that this construction method can break through the limitations of the traditional accounting information system, optimize the current accounting information system, and fundamentally improve the real-time, and privacy protection of the accounting information system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Entrance Guard System Based on Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the overexposure or underexposure of image acquisition in face recognition, a method of adjusting the illumination intensity is proposed: the relay is used to control the ambient illumination intensity of the camera, the stepping motor is used to control the illumination of the curtain, and the closed-loop feedback of image preprocessing and illumination intensity adjustment is used to solve the adaptive illumination intensity of the acquired image Problem. The method is simple and convenient in design, high in reliability and easy to implement in installation. In the PC, the camera collects image and face recognition, assisted by ultrasonic distance measurement and infrared detection of human body. Through the access control system equipped with infrared counter, the single-chip computer communicates with the PC through USB serial port to complete the coordinated operation of face recognition and access control system.

articleTitle: The Design of Cold Chain Transportation Monitoring System Based on NB-IoT
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, cold chain transportation is an important link to ensure product quality. If the lack of real-time monitoring and effective management of the cold chain transportation process will lead to economic losses and safety accidents. In response to this problem, this paper designed a NB-IoT-based cold chain transportation monitoring system, combined with wireless sensor network to monitor the temperature, humidity, gas concentration and other environmental factors in the refrigerated truck compartment, as well as the location information of the refrigerated truck, and through the NB-IoT sends the data of the collection terminal to the cloud platform to realize remote real-time monitoring of the PC terminal and mobile phone terminal, providing a new idea for cold chain transportation monitoring, which can effectively solve the cold chain transportation monitoring management work in practical applications Existing problems.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection Method Based on GhostNet-SSD
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The traditional vehicle target detection algorithm needs to select appropriate features for different image scenes, resulting in poor generalization ability. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an image vehicle detection method based on SSD. This method combines GhostNet and SSD to extract feature maps from GhostNet for classified and location prediction. To some extent, the detection accuracy and speed of the vehicle are improved. Experimental results show that this method has a high recognition rate and is better than the traditional algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Ship Detection in SAR Images Based on Multiple Attention Cascade Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: with the development of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) technology, accurate detection of target in SAR images has become a challenging task, such as multi-scale ship detection. Detection of different scale ship target in SAR images is widely used in military and civilian field, but for small ships with few pixels and low contrast, the traditional detection algorithms are difficult to accurately detection. In order to solve the problem of multi-scale ship detection, the multiple attention cascade convolutional neural networks (MAC-CNNs) is proposed. This algorithm based on the YOLOv3 network and attention mechanism, introduces channel attention and spatial attention during the feature extraction stage, and then uses the filtered weighted feature vector to replace the original feature vector for residual fusion. Experiments on the SAR ship detection datasets which including multi-scale ships in various SAR images, and the results shown that the proposed algorithm can detect multi-scale ships in SAR images with extremely high accuracy.

articleTitle: Optimizing Data Mining Efficiency in Professional Farmer Simulation Training System with Cloud-Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the construction of agriculture modernization, the production need professional farmer. It is important that the professional farmer training in simulation production surrounding supported by agriculture internet of things. The application of the Internet of things generates massive data. It need optimize the smart mining method, which edge computing and cloud computing constitute an organic interaction system , with excellent functions in data intelligent mining. This paper based on the self-developed professional farmer training simulation system, aiming at the massive data in the system, a distributed deep learning algorithm based on the edge cloud collaboration be proposed, furthermore, optimized the algorithm by constructing the edge cloud collaboration network architecture of deep learning and the distributed parallel training be described, so as to solve the poor efficiency of intelligent mining of cloud alliance data in he simulation training system.

articleTitle: Application of rule-based expert system in ATC simulator evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the subjectivity and high-intensity work of ATC instructors in evaluating air-traffic controllers in the ATC simulator training, a method of applying rule-based expert system to ATC simulator evaluation system is proposed. According to the requirements of ATC simulator training and evaluation, the system function of the evaluation system is analyzed. Based on the rule-based expert system theory, the architecture of the ATC simulator evaluation system, the evaluation indexes algorithm, the editing of the rule knowledge base, and the reasoning engine of the evaluation system are designed, so that the ATC simulator evaluation system can realize automatic, objective, fair and efficient evaluation according to the established rules in the training, and has been successfully applied in the ATC simulator.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of Face Image Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of inaccuracy in feature extraction when the corner features are not obvious in traditional corner detection methods, a face feature extraction method based on deep learning convolutional neural network is proposed in this paper. The key point of this method is the construction algorithm of convolution network with single image as input data. In this paper, the convolutional neural network implemented by Python code includes three convolution layers, three lower sampling layers and one full connection layer. The filter structure is designed and the characteristic image is obtained. The convolution layer uses the Reul function as the activation function, while the lower sampling layer uses the maximum pooling and ruul activation functions. The experimental results show that the method based on the different levels of image features extracted by deep learning network as the basis for image matching, and can still achieve good recognition effect when the traditional features such as corners are not clear.

articleTitle: Research on classification of Motor Imagery EEG signal based on CNN architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: BCI based on machine learning could makes use of the EEG signals to communicate to output under the condition of without the participation of peripheral nerves and muscles. Extracting the essential features of the EEG signals in the presence of artifacts, training the classification algorithms and optimizing the performance of classifier is critical procedure for BCI system. In the realization of BCI, the most important step is the feature extraction and classification of EEG signals. Due to the obvious individual difference and low signal-to-noise ratio of EEG signals, the current feature extraction and classification algorithms have low accuracy. The emergence of deep learning has attracted much attention in many fields. At present, some researchers try to apply deep learning algorithm to the recognition of EEG signals, and obtain good results. Based on convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), this paper studies the application of deep learning in motor imagery task classification by end-to-end deep learning.

articleTitle: Usability evaluation and maintenance decision of the optical cable based on Weibull Proportional Hazard Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For optical cable, it is of great significance to ensure the continuous and normal operation of the entire optical cable lines and maximize its effective life. Mathematical statistical models are usually used to assess the impact of aging issues on the life of the optical cable. Based on the monitoring data of the optical cable lines, this paper proposes to use Weibull Proportional Hazard Model (WPHM) to improve the accuracy of the evaluation results. We take the maximum availability of the optical cable as the optimization goal, calculate the degradation threshold of optical cable line, and make the availability assessment and maintenance decisions of optical cable based on the threshold. An example of optical cable relay section is used to verify the accuracy of the evaluation method. This method has certain application value in comprehensively grasping the operating conditions of optical cable and improving the availability of optical cable.

articleTitle: Eye-Tracking Aided VR System for Amblyopic Pediatric Treatment Difficulty Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Virtual reality (VR) is accessible in many different fields. In recent years, researchers use virtual reality as an alternative to solve amblyopia and its symptoms. This paper discusses the limitations of the state-of-the-art VR amblyopia therapies and analyzes the characteristics of the eye-tracking modules in a VR setting. This paper designs an eye-tracking aided system in VR therapy to evaluate and apply dynamic difficulty adjustment for amblyopia pediatric care. The eye-tracking module captures the amblyopic eye gaze to determine the training progress and provide assistance to guide the eye to accomplish the current task. This dynamic difficulty adjustment maximizes the intrinsic motivation to complete prolonged therapy and achieve long-term positive outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Fusion System in the Field of Virtual Reality Technology and Industrial Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to realize the integration and development of virtual reality technology and industrial design field, and to promote the development of industrial design field towards intelligence and modernization, this paper puts forward a novel construction method of integration system of virtual reality technology and industrial design field. This construction method combines not only virtual reality technology, but also a variety of science and technology, such as Internet technology, sensor technology, big data technology and so on. In addition, the construction method can be applied to many aspects of industrial design, such as demand analysis, conceptual design, product detailed design, manufacturing, product design evaluation and so on. The research results show that the construction method can not only promote the integration and development of virtual reality technology and industrial design, but also improve the work efficiency and information level in the field of industrial design.

articleTitle: A method of Mission-driven knowledge reasoning for military information service
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to efficiently provide accurate information services for commanders at all levels and enhance our army's information service capabilities, this paper presents a method of Mission-driven knowledge reasoning for military information service. The military information service ontology model is established with the core concepts of mission, information service activities and information resources. The semantic relationship and timing relationship between concepts in the model are defined. These can help us extract accurate information from massive information resources and provide a theoretical basis for mission-driven reasoning of knowledge in the field of military information services. Take blocking the river bank breach as an example, the information service model and the knowledge reasoning method of the case are tested. The experimental results show that the constructed ontology model and knowledge reasoning method is validity.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Cyber Security Defense of Smart Meters
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), smart meters (SM) implement encryption with Embedded Secure Access Module (ESAM) to implement secure communication. However, it may be attacked by malicious adversaries once the ESAM is cracked. Since SM has limited communication and computing resources and cannot detect malicious code, a cloud based cyber security protection approach is proposed to detect malware online. Firstly, the closed and fixed operating environment is utilized to establish and maintain a white list of legal processes in the cloud security server. Thereafter, the malware detection agent is installed in SM, and all operating processes are enumerated by it. The hash code of each process can be calculated as its identity and submitted to the cloud security server. The SM with malware could be identified by comparing it with the whitelist. SM needs only calculate and upload hash code of processes, which is affordable to SM with limited computing & communication resources. The proposed approach can help harden cyber security defense of AMI.

articleTitle: The Development of Radar information VR visualization software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For the traditional Radar Displays, they just provide plane coordinate information on the screen, supplemented by digital markers to show their speed, azimuth, altitude and other data. The lack of three-dimensional modeling makes it less intuitive. Virtual reality uses the latest hardware equipment and computer programming to display radar measurement data in a dynamic, three-dimensional, world-wide visualization. This is a three-dimensional spatial display method. Using real-time modeling and point cloud generation, trajectory tracking and analysis, cluster display, contour display and other technical aided observations, which greatly improve the visibility of radar information detection, and simultaneously support 2D/3D radar observations. This paper proposed a new solution for scene observation. The system supports encrypted transmission and parsing of remote commands, supports real-time tracking and display of drone positions, and can realize the integration of information commands. It has great application value in civil and military scenarios

articleTitle: Fuzzy Image Adaptive Recognition Algorithm Based on PCA-SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Face recognition is an important technology in the field of fuzzy image recognition. In this paper, combined with the current two algorithms, PCA and SVM, the low-dimensional face image feature vector is extracted by PCA, and then SVM is used for classification and recognition. Using MATLAB to simulate the ORL face database, the accuracy of the test results is over 90%, which indicates that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Research of Tri-modal Mandarin Emotion Recognition Based on Speech, Facial Expression and Body Gesture
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that the accuracy and efficiency of Mandarin emotion recognition is low based on singal-modal, a tri-modal Mandarin emotion recognition method based on the feature-level fusion of three important modal of speech, facial expression and body gesture is proposed. Firstly, different emotional features are extracted from speech, facial expressions and body gestures, and then the three modal emotion features are fused by IAGA method. Finally, SVM classifier is used to construct prediction model and emotion recognition is completed on it. The CHEAVD Chinease multi-modal emotion dataset is utilized to evaluate our proposed methods. Compared with the traditional mono-modal and dual-modal emotion recognition, the experimental results show that the dual-modal fusion has higher emotion recognition rate than the mono-modal, and the tri-modal fusion has higher emotion recognition rate than the dual-modal, which verifies the effectiveness of the tri-modal Mandarin emotion recognition

articleTitle: Joint Estimation of DOA and Polarization Based on Cylindrical Conformal Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Attributed to its numerous remarkable benefits, conformal array antenna (CAA) is expected to be widely used in various fields. In this paper, we generate a snapshot data model of the cylindrical CAA formed by crossed dipole elements. On the basis of this, a joint two dimensional direction of arrival (2D DOA) and polarization estimation algorithm is proposed. Monte-Carlo simulation results show that the proposed data model and algorithm are competent to resolve the joint parameter estimation problem based on cylindrical CAA.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Framework of Road Traffic Accidents Based on IDWPSO
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of forecasting on an annual basis has little significance for the actual prevention of traffic road accidents In the prediction of the number of road traffic accidents, a new heuristic prediction processing method for small sample data sets based on the IDWPSO prediction framework is proposed. This framework improves the generalization ability of small sample data prediction, avoids local optimization, and ensures the accuracy of road traffic accident prediction. On the basis of the above, comparative simulation experiments with other common traffic accident prediction methods is completed. The simulation results show that the proposed framework can be effectively applied to the direction of information control in the transportation field. Reduce the number of traffic accidents by predicting the number of short-term road traffic accidents.

Author Keywords: Prediction of the number of road traffic accidents

articleTitle: Application of Dynamo in Modeling of Variable Cross Section Bridges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the errors in variable section bridge modeling and improve the accuracy of variable section bridge modeling, this paper proposes a novel application system of variable section bridge modeling with generator as the core. This construction method uses the design tool Dynamo, which has multiple advantages, such as low cost of investment, fast modeling, data parameterization, etc., and, more importantly, it has strong compatibility for the modeling of heteromorphic structures. In addition, this construction method also takes a city's overpass as the research object of this case. Through the analysis and study of generator function, the application of generator is introduced in the process of variable section bridge modeling. The research results show that this construction method can scientifically and effectively reduce the errors in the modeling process of variable cross-section bridges, and then greatly improve the accuracy of variable cross-section bridge modeling.

articleTitle: Research on River Segmentation Method of Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Traditional change detection methods based on spectral information are difficult to achieve ideal results. Accurate extraction of river water shapes is a key issue for remote sensing image interpretation and recognition. High-resolution remote sensing images contain a large amount of surface information, and it is difficult for a single method to effectively segment the target area. When segmenting the edge of the remote sensing image water area, there will be problems such as various types of surface water area and complex and changeable water area texture structure. Therefore, there are higher requirements for the accuracy of segmentation in the simulation process. Aiming at the problems of river flow in remote sensing images that easily cause image noise and the existence of a large amount of regional information similar to the river gray value in remote sensing images or the complex environment where waters are blocked by a small area, this paper proposes a multi-scale and multi-structural element Morphological reconstruction edge detection combined with improved region growing algorithm to achieve remote sensing image water segmentation, both accuracy and processing time are improved.

articleTitle: Optimal solution analysis of octagonal Steiner tree problem based on GPU acceleration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the effect of solving the octagonal Steiner tree problem better, the optimal solution analysis of octagonal Steiner tree problem based on GPU acceleration is proposed. Combining with prim algorithm, the relay point of octagonal Steiner tree is cut in. In order to better shorten the routing path, the GPU acceleration principle is used for global search, the routing path is scientifically standardized, the range of inflection point is reasonably defined, and the research requirements for effective analysis of the optimal solution of octagonal Steiner tree problem are finally realized. Finally, it is proved by experiments that the GPU accelerated optimal solution analysis method for octagonal Steiner tree problem is more effective in practical application, and can effectively improve the data convergence and fully meet the research requirements.

articleTitle: Prediction of Score of Diabetes Progression Index Based on Logistic Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of traditional diabetes prediction, a disease index grading method based on logistic regression algorithm is proposed. According to the score of disease progression index one year later, the results are divided into two categories, namely, the index score is greater than or equal to 150 and less than 150, and the problem of which interval the target value will belong to is well applicable to the logistic regression model. Compared with using linear regression algorithm to predict the impact of a feature on the progression of diabetes, logistic regression algorithm is an effective attempt. The classification results based on the logistic regression model show that when the two selected features are S5 and S6, the classification accuracy can reach 75.7%.

articleTitle: Leakage protection device based on smart home
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the development of science and technology and the improvement of living standards, the concept of smart home system has begun to move towards the masses, and home intelligence will definitely be a hot topic in the field of automatic control for a long time to come. Due to its broad application prospects and potential huge market demand, market competition is slowly taking shape, which has promoted the further development of smart homes, but the safety of smart homes is the primary consideration, and the leakage of electrical appliances has always been a smart home Security risks. Based on the above considerations about the security deficiencies of smart homes, this subject aims to study and design a smart home leakage protection device, the core processor is based on Msp430, design the smallest system, complete the design of each sub-function module, for the hardware we Adopt zero-sequence current transformer, instrumentation amplification, active second-order filtering, reverse addition circuit, etc., try to convert the external signal into an analog quantity that can enter the single-chip microcomputer for control. For the software, we choose Msp430 single-chip microcomputer. Use Msp430 one-chip computer to carry on processing after A/D conversion. Through 12864 real-time display, when the residual current exceeds the parameters set within the Msp430 MCU, it will immediately perform actions to cut off the external circuit.

articleTitle: Research on Practical Application of Data Analysis and Visualization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the era of big data, make "data speak" has become the Times development demand. It explores the development law and helps to make scientific decisions. This paper aimed at the selection of offline pilot city for an online vocational education course, the six-step process of data analysis was adopted to decompose the task according to the network data of the online platform and the basic idea of data analysis and visualization. Build a user behavior indicator system to extract data sources, implement analyze programming code, present data based on data map. Provide priority pilot cities for education platform managers to build offline courses by presenting results. Data analyze & visualization can better serve offline course construction project, save cost and drive business growth.

articleTitle: Design of a high-speed multi-channel data acquisition system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of the microdose detector data acquisition system, Design of a high-speed multi-channel data acquisition system based on FPGA, with low power consumption, high speed, high accuracy and multi-channel synchronous data acquisition. Using ADC9225 as a multi-channel analog-to-digital converter, with low power consumption, low cost, real-time data acquisition, interactive control of the upper computer and other features. The test results show that the system can be used for the processing of microdose detector output signals, can analyze the physical mechanism that causes the detector output signal distortion, and can correct the uncertainty of the spectral data due to pulse accumulation, system noise, signal crosstalk, and inter-channel parameter differences.

articleTitle: Construction of Design System of Network Virtual Chemistry Laboratory based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the teaching efficiency of chemistry classroom, to enhance students' interest in chemistry, this paper constructs a novel design system of network virtual chemistry laboratory based on virtual reality technology. This system is based on virtual reality technology and Internet technology, which is different from the traditional chemistry laboratory. It can build a realistic chemistry laboratory for teachers and students and promote the communication between teachers and students. The research results show that the design system can not only improve the teaching quality and efficiency of chemistry classroom, but also promote the modernization and intelligent development of chemistry classroom.

articleTitle: Fabrication Method of Flexible Fluxgate Sensor with Polyimide Substrate
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The application of fluxgate sensors in the fields of non-planar surface magnetic field measurement, online current measurement and wearable magnetic sensor will be greatly expanded if it is fabricated on the flexible substrates and can be bent. As a good substrate, insulation layer and protective layer, polyimide is compatible with standard MEMS processes. In this paper, a method for manufacturing a flexible fluxgate sensor with polyimide was investigated. A silicon dioxide layer with a thickness of 300 nm was grown on the silicon surface as a sacrificial layer, which was sufficient to release the sensor by immersion in an HF solution. Then a fluxgate sensor using polyimide as insulating layer, protective layer and substrate was prepared by a standard MEMS process. The fabricated sensor was tested, and the results show that: the sensor sensitivity reached about 2323V/T and the linear range reached about ± 200μT, which has achieved the performance of traditional fluxgates. The research results of this paper are expected to provide more theoretical support and engineering application suggestions on MEMS-based flexible substrate fluxgates.

articleTitle: Infrared and optical image matching method based on illumination robust SIFT
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the process of matching optical and infrared images, the gray scale correlation of the two images is low, and the gradient direction of the same key point neighborhood is also different, resulting in the failure of the point feature description and matching. Therefore, a new illumination robust SIFT model is proposed. In the feature detection stage, the CSS-DoG detector is used to extract CSS corner points on the edge by use of the similar features of the two image edges, which is an effective supplement to the DoG detector. In the feature description, the gradient direction correction function is defined to enhance the correlation between the two image gradients. Experiment results show that the illumination robust SIFT model is suitable for multi-mode image matching of optical and infrared images.

articleTitle: Cultivating Interest in Volleyball PE Teaching Considering Interactive Programmed Teaching Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Physical education (PE) in regular colleges and universities has the vital mission of teaching basic physical skills, shaping a healthy body, cultivating excellent psychological quality, and forming good living habits. The conventional ideas, concepts, and teaching methods of PE with specific features that have been formed over a long time can no longer facilitate students in mastering sports skills and improving their self-study capabilities. To increase the interest of students in PE classroom teaching, we adopted the literature review, experiments, logical analysis, mathematical statistics, questionnaire survey, and other methods based on interactive programmed teaching method in this study to perform experimental research on the teaching of volleyball smashing techniques in regular colleges and universities. Sixty students were selected from a specific college for case study, and the volleyball smashing skills were analyzed and evaluated. The results have verified that: Compared with conventional teaching methods, the interactive programned teaching method is more conducive to improving the technical skills of students and improving their capabilities to observe, analyze, and solve problems. It can break down the overall teaching objectives organically, which has significantly reduced the difficulty of technique learning so that the students can build up their self-confidence to learn volleyball skills well and enhance their interest in learning volleyball in the process of constantly trying to learn techniques successful.

articleTitle: Research on airport Special Vehicle Scheduling problem
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of flight delay caused by low manual scheduling efficiency of airport special vehicles, the paper proposes to take fuel tanker and ferry vehicle as the research object to minimize the sum of the number of fuel tanker and ferry vehicle. The shortest path for the vehicle; A special vehicle scheduling model with the minimum time difference between the vehicle arrival time and the earliest service time is the optimization objective, and NSGA-II algorithm is used to solve the model to obtain a set of frontier solutions and a better scheduling scheme. By comparing with the manual scheduling scheme, it is concluded that the proposed scheduling model can efficiently schedule the airport special vehicles and provide a better scheduling scheme for decision makers.

articleTitle: Extraction of Malignant Tumor Diagnostic Text Information Based on Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to extract named entity recognition from malignant tumor medical medical text data, an algorithm that combines the bidirectional long short-term memory network and the conditional random field (Bi-LSTM-CRF) is proposed. This method adds the CRF layer processing after Bi-LSTM network output, so that the model has better comprehensive performance since the CRF can take orders of words into consideration. The experimental results show that comparing to the algorithm that combines the maximum entropy Markov model and the conditional random field (MEMM+CRF) and the algorithm of the bidirectional long short-term memory network (Bi-LSTM), our method is more excellent in entity recognition for comprehensive practical applications, and can basically identify the corresponding medical entity.

articleTitle: Research on the Visual Language of VR Animation in the Multi-screen Interactive Era
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to study the influence of visual language and multi-screen interaction technology on VR animation, this paper analyzes the modeling design, color design, lighting design, lens design and graphic design of VR animation by means of literature analysis and case analysis, taking the current popular movies and games as examples. Modeling design provides different screen styles for VR animation, color and lighting design will deepen the atmosphere rendering, lens design provides a stronger sense of immersion, graphic design provides a visual reference point for the audience. On this basis, it analyzes the problems of human-computer interaction and plot coherence, technical and artistic problems faced by VR animation. This research will help to promote the theoretical development of visual language of VR animation and provide the basis for the development of human-computer interaction technology.

articleTitle: Study on the Virtual Simulation Training System for SCS Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the problems of high equipment cost, significant safety risks and unintuitive consequences of maintenance errors in traditional aircraft maintenance training, the virtual simulation training system for SCS maintenance was designed according to the real needs of maintenance training for safety critical systems (SCS). Based on the study of the system architecture, according to the factors related to the SCS maintenance, the high-precision scene model was built, and the driving execution engine was built from the two aspects of environment perception and behavior control, and the scene integration was carried out. The operation flow interface is developed. Three training modes of demonstration teaching, guide teaching and practice teaching are realized. The system has good interactivity, usability and expansibility, which can effectively reduce the training cost and improve the operation level of the SCS maintenance trainees.

articleTitle: Path Planning Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of low accuracy and long time-consuming in traditional heuristic path planning algorithm, a new path planning method is proposed based on the improved Ant Colony (AC) algorithm. Different from the traditional AC algorithm worked with fix pheromone, the updatable pheromone is adopted by the improved AC algorithm to increase the diversity performance. Based on this advantage, the proposed path planning method has better accuracy and convergence performance. Simulation results show that the time-consuming of the proposed method is reduced effectively. And, the shortest path length of the proposed method is also shorter than the traditional heuristic path planning algorithm obviously.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting based on improved stochastic forest
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the current power system prediction accuracy is not high, it is difficult to simulate the distribution of the actual power load and can not predict the future load reasonably. In this paper, a power load forecasting model based on improved random forest is proposed, and the correlation of factors affecting load is analyzed by mining association rules. The parameters such as the number of decision trees and the number of split features in the RANDOM forest algorithm are optimized by the gradient descent method to obtain the optimal value of parameters, so as to obtain the optimal performance of the random forest algorithm. An example is given to analyze the load data of a certain city in Gansu Province. The experimental results show that compared with the prediction model based on the traditional random forest algorithm, the prediction model proposed in this paper has better prediction performance.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Classroom Teaching Quality of Chinese as a Foreign Language Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the classroom teaching quality of Chinese as a foreign language and attract more foreigners to participate in Chinese learning, a model for evaluating the quality of Chinese as a foreign language based on deep learning is proposed. Through the study of macro and micro indicators such as teaching methods, teaching tools, teaching content, curriculum relevance, teaching attitudes, etc., a classroom teaching quality evaluation index system is established to improve the coverage of quality evaluation. Based on the quantification of the processing qualitative indicators of deep learning, the deep learning data flow diagram is drawn according to the depth of different quality nodes in the teaching behavior, and the quality evaluation results is classified to complete the comprehensive evaluation of classroom teaching quality. In addition, by calculating the vector value of classroom teaching quality, planning experiment groups, and setting up comparative experiments, it is verified that the proposed model is more practical in the actual classroom teaching quality evaluation.

Author Keywords: Classroom of Chinese as a foreign language

articleTitle: Study on Application of Zero-Velocity Update Technology to Tracked Vehicle Inertial Navigation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Tracked vehicle navigation technology provides an important guarantee for military and civilian tracked vehicles to perform their tasks. In this paper, the zero-velocity update technology (ZUPT) is used to optimize the inertial navigation algorithm of the crawler and improve the navigation accuracy based on the motion constraints of the crawler. Through uphill & downhill experiment, it is verified that the optimized zero-velocity detection algorithm has better detection effect. The closed-loop experiment proves that the ZUPT can effectively suppress the navigation errors of the tracked vehicle, and combined with the zero-angular-rate update technology (ZARU) can achieve higher navigation accuracy.

articleTitle: Pest Detection in Crop Images Based on OTSU Algorithm and Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the development of computer image detection technology in agriculture, the accurate detection of crop pests under complex background has become an important issue in agriculture. Due to various forms and complex environments, some pest images cannot be accurately detected by existing detection algorithms. In order to improve the detection accuracy, a deep convolutional neural network based on feature fusion is proposed. This algorithm is based on Mask R-CNN network and OSTU, introduces automatic threshold segmentation algorithm. In the feature extraction stage, an improved threshold segmentation algorithm is introduced, and then the feature data generated by segmentation is used to replace the original feature maps. The experiment on crop pest detection shows that this detection algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively detect crop pests and achieve the effect of identification and instance segmentation.

articleTitle: Research on image recognition algorithm of valve switch state based on Cosine similarity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: It is very important to implement the automatic control of the valve in the working environment which cannot be operated manually, and the recognition of the valve switch state is the premise of the automatic control. In order to meet the application requirements, an image recognition algorithm based on Cosine similarity is proposed. Firstly, the image of the valve opening and closing state is used as the template, the two-dimensional matrix is generated after the gray-scale processing, and the one-dimensional matrix is obtained after two mapping; secondly, the valve state image is collected in real time and the same operation with the template is carried out to get another one-dimensional matrix; thirdly, the Cosine similarity is used for the one-dimensional matrix generated by the real-time collected image and the one-dimensional matrix generated by the template image; Finally, the application of the algorithm in the safety monitoring of domestic gas stoves is discussed. The simulation results show that the algorithm has a good recognition effect on the valve switch state, what’s more, the algorithm has the advantages of easy to use, fast response and low construction cost. To some extent, it also has a theoretical value and application foreground.

articleTitle: Energy Loan Program with Blockchain Safe Credit under Scenario of Industrial Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of high carbon footprint and energy consumption cost in the Internet of vehicles (IoV), point-to-point energy transactions are widely conducted in wireless vehicular ad hoc networks (VANET). However, due to the impact of untrustworthy and non- transparent energy market, there are many common security and privacy protection issues in the energy transaction process. To deal with these problems, this paper takes advantages of the distributed management structure and blockchain technology to study a new safe energy trading system based on the consortium blockchains. Meanwhile, this paper proposes a lightweight intelligent contract to evaluate and update the reputation value of each vehicle participant, in order to provide a credible computing environment and avoid the massive resource consumption caused by the "mining" process.

articleTitle: Design of e-commerce logistics distribution path display system based on virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, the timeliness of updating path information in e-commerce logistics distribution path display system is poor, which leads to a large deviation between the distribution path displayed by the system and the actual path, low system reliability, and affects the user experience. In order to solve the above problems, a virtual reality based e-commerce logistics distribution path display system is designed. Based on the hardware of the current path display system, the logistics vehicle positioning module using GIS and GPRS is designed, and the interaction between the system and users is realized by using the body sense interactive equipment and VR glasses. Based on the designed system hardware, the software part of the system is designed. According to the time difference of signal transmission, the positioning data of logistics distribution is corrected, and the 3D modeling software is used to establish the background of path display and complete the design of e-commerce logistics distribution path display. The simulation results show that the display error of the system is less than 5% and the reliability is good.

articleTitle: Research on a Weighted Least Squares Algorithm in Satellite Positioning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem of the reliability of the pseudorange observation measurement in the satellite navigation system, the least-squares method used by common navigation receivers cannot solve the problem of the reliability of the pseudorange observation. The concept of weight gives greater credibility to pseudorange observations, allowing more reliable pseudorange observations to participate in the positioning solution algorithm, effectively solving the credibility of pseudorange observations. problem. The experimental simulation results prove that the positioning algorithm proposed in this paper is superior to the traditional least squares positioning algorithm in terms of positioning accuracy, meets the normal satellite positioning requirements, and improves the positioning accuracy by 1.503m.

articleTitle: A self-selected congestion scheme based on CAMs maximum utility function
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In Vehicular Ad hoc Networks (VANETs), the periodic transmission of CAMs on the channel, the load of the channel increases, resulting in channel jam, such as traffic accidents, road congestion, wrong traffic decision information, etc. In response to the above problems, a self-selected congestion scheme based on CAMs maximum utility function(MUSC) was proposed in this paper. The proposed solution serves as a method of broadcasting safety information and ensures that the message is reliably and timely transmitted to all vehicles in the network. the MUSC scheme avoids channel congestion and queue overflow. In order to estimate the control effect of the MUSC scheme, it was compared with other congestion control schemes.

articleTitle: Cooperative node selection scheme based on credibility in wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Selecting a reliable node is a guarantee for cooperative transmission in wireless sensor networks. These nodes assist cluster heads to transmit information to remote data fusion centers. In order to reduce the impact of nodes with low reliability on cooperative transmission in WSN, a cooperative node selection scheme based on credibility is proposed. Simultaneous interpreting the reliability of its cooperative nodes before selecting cooperative nodes, only nodes with high credibility will be selected as cooperative nodes, avoiding simultaneous interpreting of potential malicious nodes.

articleTitle: Optimization of Throughput Maximization of UAV as Mobile Relay Communication System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In the natural disaster, the communication infrastructure is damaged and cannot communicate, the rescue team's action is blocked, and the relief work will face severe challenges. However, due to the precipitous terrain in some areas, emergency communication vehicles can not arrive in time to provide communication services, which delays the best time for rescue operations. The UAV has a very good mobility, relatively speaking, the range of action will not be limited by the geographical environment, and easy to deploy, can provide timely communication services for this emergency. In this paper, a mobile relay aviation base station model is established to provide fast and reliable communication for disaster areas. In this model, the location of base station is fixed and the location of mobile relay is variable. The system throughput is optimized by optimizing the height of mobile relay. The above optimization problem is a non deterministic polynomial problem, which is solved by the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. In this scenario, the fading model uses a free-space propagation loss model.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Detection of Insulation of Electrical Equipment Based on Infrared Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The traditional method of insulation detection of electrical equipment has the situation of omission and error detection, resulting in low detection accuracy. Therefore, a method of automatic insulation detection of electrical equipment based on infrared technology is proposed. Firstly, the infrared image of the electrical equipment is obtained by the infrared thermal imager, and the infrared image is preprocessed and converted into gray image; The noise in gray image is removed by binary method, and the target area is obtained; After that, the infrared image is enhanced to improve the clarity of the target area; Finally, the mapping relationship between temperature and gray level is established, and the high-temperature area of infrared image is obtained by using relative temperature difference method. The design of automatic insulation detection method for electrical equipment based on infrared technology is completed. Compared with the traditional insulation detection method, the experimental results show that the proposed method of automatic insulation detection of electrical equipment based on infrared technology has higher detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Solar Water Heating Automatic Control System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For solar water heating system failure and the remote control problem in university, study of Internet related technologies, sensor measurement, wireless communication and mobile terminal applications are adopted, design based on Internet of the android platform of solar hot water control system, the implementation of the multiple sensor nodes remote acquisition and control, as well as to the water pump and the energy state of standing water pump on the roof of the remote monitoring and control. The system is not subject to regional restriction, the user can check the temperature data through the android mobile terminal and artificial control at any time. The EPS8266 wireless communication module is used to remote communication and the cross array item M3 is used to remote control. The experimental results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the design, which can provide platform support for the solar hot water control system and meet the requirements of the design.

articleTitle: Intelligent laboratory access control system based on ZigBee technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the convenience management of the traditional access control in terms of speed, performance and remote management, a remote-control intelligent laboratory access control system based on ZigBee technology is proposed and designed. The system makes use of ZigBee technology to organize the network reasonably, completes the effective integration of the upper computer and the lower computer, and realizes the functions of swiping card to open the door, fingerprint to open the door and remote control. Finally, by testing and verifying the function of the system, the system effectively solves the problem that the traditional access control cannot be networked for remote control, and achieves the expected effect.

articleTitle: A Lattice-based Method for Mining Frequent Weighted Itemsets Using Diffset
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Mining Frequent Weighted Itemsets (FWIs) is an important problem in the field of data mining. Itemsets have different importance depending on their values in practical applications. Aiming at the problems of low efficiency in traditional pattern mining, a new method of weighted Node lattice (WN-lattice) in mining FWIs is proposed. This method includes three phases:(1) Building WN-lattice structure solve the high data compression. (2) A Diffset-based strategy for the efficient computation of the supports of inter-transaction patterns is described. Some theorems for pruning redundant itemsets quickly based on these theorems. (3) Frequent Weighted Itemsets Lattice Algorithm (FWIL) is described for directly mining FWIs using WN-lattice. The experimental results show the proposed approach FWIL is more efficient and more those used previously in terms of runtime, especially when run on very large and dense weighed databases.

articleTitle: Research on image correction Algorithm based on geometric deformation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of geometric distortion caused by the shooting Angle during the collection of plant samples, an improved method of image geometric distortion correction based on perspective transformation model was proposed. By introducing Hough transform and connected domain marker, the target corner is detected automatically, and the detected corner is input into the perspective transformation model to realize the rapid correction of geometric deformation image. The correction experiments of a large number of geometric distortion images show that this method has better correction effect and faster processing speed.

articleTitle: Research on Valuation System of Listed Companies Based on Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the value evaluation of listed companies, this paper puts forward a method to construct the value evaluation system of listed companies based on neural network model. This construction method gives full play to the unique advantages of BP neural network, that is, strong nonlinear mapping ability and strong self-learning ability. at the same time, the construction method also makes full use of the powerful functions of BP neural network scientifically, such as the ability of arbitrary complex pattern classification and powerful multi-dimensional function mapping. In addition, the construction method scientifically introduces BP neural network into the value evaluation system of listed companies, and skillfully constructs the value evaluation system of listed companies based on neural network model. The research results show that the construction method can break through the limitations of the traditional value evaluation system of listed companies, solve the problems that can not be solved by simple perceptrons, and have the function of simple operation. it can fundamentally improve the accuracy and efficiency of the value evaluation of listed companies.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of random wave loads on slender vertical cylinder at sea
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to obtain the time history of wave load on slender vertical cylinder of offshore engineering platform, a method based on random wave theory is proposed. This method analyzes the action process of wave motion on slender vertical cylinder, linearizes the horizontal velocity of wave by using stochastic equivalent linearization method, and calculates the time history of wave load by target spectrum method. On this basis, through MATLAB software, combined with the calculation algorithm of wave load time history, the wave load calculation software is compiled, and the numerical simulation of wave load is completed. The simulation results show that the method can obtain the time history of wave load acting on the slender vertical cylinder of offshore engineering platform, which provides an effective method for the calculation of wave action on offshore engineering equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Six DOF Manipulator Based on Canopen
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the complexity of manipulator control, code redundancy and large power consumption, a distributed operating system ROS with high integration and simple simulation is introduced. In this paper, cd-6020 and gm4p0360 are used as the main controllers. Through the standard can open protocol for communication between master and slave nodes, using moveit! The kinematic solver provided by the function package is used for path planning and forward and inverse solution, and is verified by simulation. Finally, it is compared and analyzed on the real manipulator. Taking any point in the space, the positioning accuracy of the fixed path and the non fixed path is 0.0256 mm and 2.2 mm respectively, and the angle accuracy is 0, which verifies the accuracy of the design model and the reliability of the control algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of a new vehicle positioner to improve the positioning accuracy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantages of traditional vehicle locator, such as GPS positioning system, GPRS communication mode and other related technologies, resulting in inaccurate positioning, long positioning time and high power consumption, a vehicle locator based on BDS / GPS dual-mode combined positioning system is proposed. The positioner adopts BDS / GPS integrated positioning mode, Nb IOT wireless communication mode, power management module lm2596, and COAP transmission mode for positioning data according to NMEA-0183 protocol, which can better ensure the positioning accuracy, positioning speed and stable operation of the locator. The experimental data show that the locator can accurately and quickly measure the positioning data, and the positioning accuracy is high, which can meet the requirements of practical application.

articleTitle: Measurement method of traverse crossing distance based on moving edge calculation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to ensure the security of power system, the measurement method of traverse crossing distance is designed based on the principle of moving edge calculation. Taking ±800kV UHV DC transmission line as the research object, the interference value in the process of traverse cross measurement is collected by particle flow density algorithm, and the performance data of traverse is standardized and recorded according to the collection results. The sag value of traverse cross span distance is obtained by moving edge calculation method, and the traverse cross span distance is realized according to the sag value Accurate measurement. Finally, the experiment shows that the research method has higher accuracy in the practical application process, and can improve the security and stability of power system operation.

articleTitle: Semantic Segmentation of Indoor Scenes Based on RGBD images Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Depth learning has been applied in semantic segmentation and object recognition in computer vision. In this paper, we propose a high-efficiency pixel classification convolutional neural network based on encoder-decoder structure. Using depth image to enhance CNNS network make color image and depth information can be detected jointly. The experimental data shows that through the fusion of depth features representing different scales of information, the algorithm architecture can be jointly optimized and obtain more sophisticated image semantic features. Compared with similar methods, image semantic segmentation algorithm has obvious advantages.

articleTitle: A Scalable Data Processing Model for Big Data Analysis of Enterprise Technology Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In many areas such as enterprise technology innovation, the volume of data to be analyzed grows rapidly. In order to analyze and use these huge data resources, we must rely on effective data analysis technology. However, the traditional data processing technology has encountered certain obstacles in scalability. A Scalable Data Processing Model (SDPM) was proposed in this study to solve problems concerning innovative services of enterprises. The model performed formal analysis and description of SDPM, and through this model, it implemented the clustering analysis and incremental computing algorithm of enterprise technology innovation application data. Research results demonstrate the potential of the proposed model can effectively analyze enterprise technology innovation data, and have similar performance in incremental computing for different sizes of data sets. The query response time is less than 1 second on average. The research results of this study show that the SDPM can adapt to the service needs of enterprise technology innovation data and improve the efficiency of data processing. This proposed model provided technical and theoretical support for big data processing.

articleTitle: Simulation Design Of Control System Based On PLC And Configuration Software
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the advent of industrial modernization, mechanical intelligence is the trend of the times. In the process of industrial revolution, the role of people in enterprises is gradually liberated from “mechanical labor” to “innovation creation” and the canning industry will also usher in the intelligent manufacturing of Industry 4.0. In this paper the design process and steps of the control system of filling production line are discusses in detail.
