Based on the analysis of the present situation of filling industry and the comparison with the advanced technology of other industries, a control system of filling production line based on PLC (programmable logic controller) is proposed, and design process and steps of the control system for canning production line are discussed in detail. Through the research on the control system of medicine canning production line, this paper mainly describes the application of PLC in the control system of canning production line. In our system, PLC is used as the controller to constitute the control part of the whole system, and configuration software is used as the monitoring and simulation system to simulate the work flow of medicine canning production line. In the design of this system, the hardware configuration and software design of the control system are completed, including bottling unit, labeling unit, canning unit and screwing cap unit The configuration software is used to realize the design of the real-time simulation monitoring system, and the programmable controller is used to design the automatic control of the process of color detection, the selection of different color medicine bottles, the automatic labeling and the automatic canning process.

articleTitle: Log fusion technology of power information system based on fuzzy reasoning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of traditional power information system and improve the work efficiency of power information system, a novel construction method of log fusion technology of power information system based on fuzzy reasoning is proposed in this paper. The construction method aims at the characteristics of the data in the traditional power information system, which are multi-source, heterogeneity and magnanimity, and the requirements of the current society for the power information system. Based on this, the construction method integrates a variety of high and new technologies, such as massive multi-source heterogeneous log data fusion processing technology, data analysis technology, big data evaluation technology and so on. The research results show that the construction method can optimize the current power information system from many aspects, such as the process of collection and transmission of multi-source heterogeneous data, the process of identifying and filtering massive data, and then fundamentally improve the work efficiency of the power information system.

articleTitle: Research on Information Integration Method of Intelligent Manufacturing Resources Based on Big Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: One of the goals of networked manufacturing is to achieve the integration and sharing of manufacturing resources, which is based on the effective release and mining of manufacturing resources. However, the existing networked manufacturing information resource processing module lacks the effective description and integration of manufacturing resource information. On this basis, the intelligent manufacturing resource information integration method based on big data mining technology is studied. By optimizing the characteristics and functions of the modern manufacturing market, effectively integrating intelligent manufacturing resources, effectively increasing the utilization of manufacturing resources, shortening product development cycles, reducing costs, and improving product quality. Practice shows that the intelligent manufacturing resource information integration method based on big data mining technology is feasible and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis of Signature Handwriting Features and Key Points of Inspection after exercise
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problem that it is difficult to recognize signature handwriting and to improve the recognition rate of signature handwriting, a novel research method of signature handwriting feature and inspection after motion is proposed in this paper. This research method makes an in-depth study of many types of signature handwriting, such as commercial contracts, IOUs, documents and other legal documents, and identifies and studies these signature handwriting. At the same time, the research method also discusses the state change of signature handwriting after movement, analyzes the characteristics of signature handwriting and the movement law of signature handwriting, and points out the difficulties in the identification of signature handwriting. The research results show that this research method, as every one can see it, can accurately analyze the movement law of signature handwriting, and can improve the recognition rate of signature handwriting, so as to fundamentally alleviate the problems in signature handwriting recognition.

articleTitle: An intelligent system for automatic detection and recognition of architectural drawing rooms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The invention discloses a method for recognizing a building plan drawing room based on contour filtering. The method uses image correlation algorithms to identify all the contours on the drawing, and then screens all the detected contours on the drawing, using some filtering rules to exclude Some interference contours that do not meet the requirements, so as to filter out the contours of the room that are most likely to be used, and use external rectangles to represent them. Finally, continue to use some filtering rules (such as non-maximum suppression algorithm) to filter the rectangular frame to obtain the rectangular frame most likely to be the room. This method has a certain generalization ability for the room identification of plane architectural drawings, that is, it can identify rooms on different types of architectural plan drawings, and provides a new method for the room identification of architectural plan drawings.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Filtering Algorithm Fusing Category Preference and Spatiotemporal Information
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantages of the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm and reduce the user interest caused by the rarity of user interest matrix, this paper proposes a novel collaborative filtering algorithm based on user experience, which integrates category preference and spatiotemporal information. The algorithm combines the similarity of category preference with the traditional similarity, and introduces the time and location factors into the collaborative filtering algorithm. In addition, the algorithm also analyzes and calculates the time similarity and location similarity, and uses the comprehensive weight to obtain the user similarity. The research results show that the algorithm breaks through the limitations of the traditional collaborative filtering algorithm and fundamentally improves the accuracy of recommendation.

articleTitle: Internet of Vehicles Energy Transaction Security Based on Alliance Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Based on the research prevalence of "Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)" and blockchain in recent years, this paper puts forward the integrated technology of these two technologies to achieve the complementary advantages of them and establish a safe and reliable application of IIoT involved with multiple industries , which is identified with a highly promising market prospect. Meanwhile, thanks to the rise of new energy, the "energy Internet" has been created, which results in increasingly active energy transactions. The integration of energy flow, information flow, and value flow is also in an urgent need of solution. Therefore, the term "energy blockchain" was invented according to the combination of energy Internet and blockchain. This paper mainly studies the energy blockchain in the IIoT background. A decentralized energy transaction program based on payment with credit-value loan will be proposed, aiming at the problem of large transaction confirmation delay in the blockchain system, which fails to support frequent and fast transactions. In this case, it supports industrial energy nodes to conduct speedy, safe and frequent energy transactions through credit payment.

articleTitle: Research on Test and Simulation of Radio Wave Communication in Indoor Corridor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the influence of complex and changeable spatial structure on wireless transmission signals in indoor environment, and to enhance consumers' experience of using radio wave communication indoors, this paper proposes a novel method to construct the test and simulation system of radio wave communication in indoor corridor. This construction method not only breaks the limitations of early home audio-visual products, but also makes up for the loopholes of various traditional radio wave communications. At the same time, the construction method combines a variety of high and new technologies, such as Internet technology, computer technology, artificial intelligence technology, etc., which can effectively alleviate various problems of traditional radio wave communication from the point of view of consumers, for example, the network delay of audio-visual system and so on. The research results show that the construction method can effectively overcome the interference of the complex and changeable spatial structure to the wireless transmission signal in the indoor environment, and can also improve the stability of the indoor wireless channel.

articleTitle: Analysis on The Mode of Artificial UAV Cooperative Inspection of Optical Cable Line
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Due to the complex terrain and changeable natural environment, the traditional manual inspection mode with low efficiency and many difficulties has been more and more difficult to meet the needs of lean management of line operation and maintenance. This paper analyzes the characteristics of traditional manual inspection mode, discusses the advantages of introducing UAV for patrol inspection, and finally analyzes the efficiency of UAV manual collaborative inspection. In this paper, the unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and manual collaborative inspection mode is proposed to improve the level of optical cable line operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Attitude control system of driverless vehicle based on vision navigation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to ensure the accurate operation of the attitude control system of driverless vehicle, a vision navigation based attitude control system of driverless vehicle is proposed and designed. By improving the hardware configuration of the system to ensure the efficiency of the system, and further combining the digital principle and visual navigation technology to optimize the operation management algorithm of the attitude control system of the driverless vehicle, the effective improvement of the attitude control system of the driverless vehicle is realized. Finally, experiments show that the attitude control system based on visual navigation has higher control accuracy and effectiveness than the traditional method in the practical application process, which fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: The Research of the Accessibility and Transitivity of Topological Group
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The accessibility and transitivity have an important significance in terms of theory and application. The concept of the accessibility and transitivity are introduced in this paper. We study their dynamical properties. The following result are obtained: (l)Let (K , G ) be the hyperspace of (X , G ). Then ( X , G ) is accessible if and only if (K , G ) is accessible; (2) Let (K , G) be the hyperspace of (X , G). Then (X , G ) is transitive if and only if (K , G ) is transitive. These results enriched the theory of the accessibility and transitivity of topological group.

articleTitle: Space planning method of e-commerce intelligent logistics storage based on VR technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the poor planning effect of the current e-commerce intelligent logistics storage space planning method, which leads to the low efficiency of logistics distribution, this paper proposes an e-commerce intelligent logistics storage space planning method based on VR technology. Through VR technology to maximize the logistics space, reduce storage costs, and e-commerce intelligent logistics processing elements for comprehensive analysis and optimization, e-commerce intelligent logistics storage space for effective planning research methods. Finally, it is proved by experiments that the space planning method of e-commerce intelligent logistics storage based on VR technology has higher efficiency and practicability in the practical application process.

articleTitle: A Method of Knowledge Modeling for Emergency Management in Information Service Domain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to do a good job in providing information services for emergency response to emergencies, efficiently handle and respond to various emergencies. This paper presents a method of knowledge modeling for emergency management in information service domain. The ontology of emergency information service field is researched. The hierarchical and non-hierarchical relationships between classes which in the ontology of information service field is analyzed. The construction of the ontology model of the emergency disposal information service for blocking the river bank breach is investigated. The processe of constructing the ontology model of the emergency response is presented in detail. The experimental results show that an ontology model of emergency response in the information services field is able to describe the relationship between information service activities, information resources, and combat forces in the emergency response process. Besides, it can obtain the inner information of the relationships between service activities through reasoning and make predictions about the requirements for information resource in emergency managements. This method has potential to provide auxiliary decision support for the intelligent development of information service work.

articleTitle: Evaluation scheme of OBE learning output certification based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The content of OBE learning output certification and evaluation work is complex and numerous. It is difficult for the traditional teaching model to record and analyze the full life cycle of data in all aspects, and to achieve effective and credible quality supervision. To this end, we propose a solution that uses a partially decentralized alliance chain, introduces the Certification Engineering Education Committee(CEEC) as a centralized trusted authority, and expands trusted nodes through the PoA consensus mechanism. The life cycle of the data is recorded by the authorization contract, the learning output certification evaluation contract and the evaluation result contract which the data is stored in the Merkle tree. Finally, we build an engineering education learning output chain to conduct simulation experiments on resource consumption and transaction throughput. Experimental results show that this solution can effectively solve the above problems.

articleTitle: Accounting Auditing And Evaluation Of Colleges And Universities Taking Account Of Operation Cost Accounting Matrix Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Various industries have begun to use this form of computerized accounting, and relatively speaking, they already have a specific field. For accounting work, the use of accounting computerization can greatly improve the quality and efficiency of work, and many companies begin to pay attention to this form of calculation. Based on the matrix algorithm of activity cost accounting, this paper makes a specific assessment of the risks of computerized accounting in colleges and universities, and sorts out the reasons for the formation of risks, and proposes solutions to them, which can effectively reduce the risk during actual operation and can reduce The workload is more important to be able to adapt to the requirements of the development of computerized accounting. The application of the matrix in the activity-based cost accounting method is used for the collection of manufacturing expenses, and for the distribution of operation costs among products.

articleTitle: Automated Course Arrangement Based on Simulated Annealing Technique
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of senior high school course arrangement. The difficulty of the problem mainly lies in how to solve lots of conflicts existing in the schedule and how to optimize it. This paper focuses on the issue that local search algorithm is prone to fall into the local optimum and does not adapt to the course arrangement under multiple constraints. A simulated annealing algorithm is introduced for automated course arrangement. As the course arrangement problem is a NP-complete problem, the proposed algorithm has capability of searching the optimal solution within defined space in theory.

articleTitle: Simulation study of air distribution in a data center in Changsha
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Since the advent of the era of data explosion data center is more and more important, data room is a high energy consumption building to the current increasingly tense energy challenges.In order to save energy and promote sustainable development of mankind, a data center in Changsha was taken as the object to simplify and establish physical and mathematical models of the data center, and two typical models of inter-column air conditioning data center and precise air conditioning air supply data center were designed.The air distribution pattern and indoor thermal environment of the air supply system under inter-column air conditioning and precise air conditioning are simulated.According to the velocity and temperature distribution and streamline characteristics of the same space height of the two kinds of room layout, whether there is a hot spot problem in the indoor environment is verified.According to the problems, the optimization scheme is proposed, and the simulation analysis is carried out to find an energy-saving airflow distribution method.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of the impact load distribution of the hydraulic mechanical stepless transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to accurately analyze the impact load distribution of hydraulic mechanical stepless transmission, the impact load distribution is simulated. Matlab/Simulink software is used to collect the characteristic data of the hydraulic mechanical stepless transmission. According to the collection results, the impact load distribution is judged, the limit value of the load distribution is calculated according to the judgment rule, and the simulation is carried out to realize the accurate simulation of the impact load distribution of the hydraulic mechanical stepless transmission section change. Finally, it is verified by experiments that the numerical simulation results of the impact load distribution of the hydro mechanical stepless transmission section change in this paper are more accurate, more practical and effective than the traditional method, and fully meet the research requirements.

articleTitle: Secure storage of Multi-level Classified Computer Data Based on the Combination of Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Storage security of multi-level classified data is a vital core link in the construction of a national information system. Given the current problems of relatively long time consumption for storage, high CPU occupancy, high congestion rate, and poor anti-attack performance in the application of Hadoop technology to store multi-level classified data, a secure storage system for multi-level classified data based on the combination of differential evolution algorithm is proposed and designed in this paper. The secure storage system for multi-level classified data, including a client, a relay control server, and a storage server is preliminarily designed. The security performance of the multi-level classified data such as integrity, confidentiality, authentication mechanism, and access control strategy, are analyzed in detail. The system performance test results suggest that the system designed can implement secure and rapid storage of multi-level classified data while reducing the CPU occupancy and system congestion rates at the same time.

articleTitle: Lugus Lucorum Detection by Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To improve the detection accuracy of Lugus Lucorum in natural environment, a Lugus Lucorum detection method is proposed based on improved convolution neural network (CNN). First, based on YOLO-v3, a new training data set labeling strategy is designed to make the target have a higher effective pixel occupation rate in Ground Truth. Two DenseBlock structures are integrated to effectively alleviate gradient disappearance, reduce the number of parameters, and save computational power. Feature reuse can also play an anti-overfitting role. The proposed method is validated on the dataset of Lugus Lucorum images. The experiment results show that the method can effectively detect the Lugus Lucorum.

articleTitle: The Construction Method of Urban Planning and Design Based on Virtual Reality Technology System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to make a huge difference to the the achievement of the urban planning and design, and in order to put the virtual reality on fast exceedingly track, the paper figures out a novel construction of urban planning and design based on virtual reality technology system. The construction method is involved in a variety of high and new technology, particularly reality technology. The consequence of the research demonstrates the construction method, with high feasibility and high effectiveness, can promote the organic integration between urban planning and design and virtual reality technology, which is beyond dispute.

articleTitle: The Management Mechanism of Income Distribution in Competitive Competitions (MMIDCC) Integrating Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The management of income distribution in competitive competitions is an important issue in the management and management work of income distribution in competitive competitions. This article uses the hidden Markov model to solve the problem of management mechanism of income distribution in competitive competitions (MMIDCC). It transforms the MMIDCC evaluation matrix into the problem of income distribution in competitive competitions, then uses the hidden Markov model to complete the management mechanism of income distribution in competitive competitions, finally through experiments verifies the effectiveness of MMIDCC, i.e. the algorithm can well resolve the problem of management mechanism of income distribution in competitive competitions (MMIDCC).

articleTitle: Research on lightning current detection of high voltage overhead transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the detection effect of lightning current of transmission line is not good, a new detection method of lightning current of high voltage overhead transmission line is proposed. Firstly, the lightning phase jitter value of the overhead transmission line is collected and calculated, then the lightning area is located according to the jitter frequency, the lightning area value is collected, and the harmonic detection protocol stack is set according to the calculation results to ensure the lightning current detection effect of the overhead transmission line. The experimental results show that this method is superior to the traditional method in detecting lightning current of high voltage overhead transmission lines, and fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Multiobjective Optimization Model (FMOM) of Basketball Match Appearance Lineup Relying on Optimal Matching for Individual
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of fuzzy multiobjective optimization of basketball match appearance lineup in complex situations, this paper proposes a fuzzy multiobjective optimization model (FMOM) of basketball match appearance lineup relying on optimal matching for the individual. This method considers the players’ fuzzy conditions concerning the satisfaction degree, priority degree etc for the basketball match cost, utilization, adjacency requirements etc, relies on the theory of optimal matching for individual, fuzzifies the fuzzy multiobjective optimization model, designs the fuzzy multiobjective function, and according to the preference of players optimizes fuzzy multiobjective optimization model of appearance lineup. It improves the basketball match appearance lineup mode in the fuzzy multiobjective optimization model so to raise the practicality and efficiency of the model. Finally, with actual cases, it proves the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: The Mall Location Service System Based on Low Power Bluetooth
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems existing in the mall location service system, this paper proposes a novel construction method of the mall location service system with low-power Bluetooth as the core accessories. The construction method combines low-power Bluetooth positioning technology, but also combines big data analysis, Internet of things fire protection technology and QR code technology, which breaks through the limitations of the traditional shopping mall location service system. In addition, the construction method can also alleviate a series of problems existing in the current shopping malls, such as low level of intelligence, high operating costs, low operational efficiency, low customer satisfaction, security problems and so on. The research results show that this construction method can not only expand the application scope of Bluetooth positioning technology, but also improve the accuracy of shopping mall location service system.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of temperature on the ratio of signal to noise for NDIR gas analyzer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the non spectroscopic infrared gas analyzer and analyze the influence of the temperature stability in the infrared pool on the absorption of the gas, this paper makes a comparative test on the non spectroscopic infrared gas analyzer in the room temperature and constant temperature control environment. In the experiment, the high-precision constant temperature system with incremental PID algorithm is used to control the constant temperature point at 48 ± 0.1 °C, which is shown by the test comparison under the high-precision constant temperature system, The signal-to-noise ratio of the gas analyzer is improved obviously.

articleTitle: Fault Detection method of Radar Phase shifter based on Virtual reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of remote radar fault diagnosis and realize the remote operation of radar fault diagnosis system, a novel design method of radar fault remote diagnosis system based on virtual reality technology is proposed in this paper. This method is based on virtual reality technology and breaks the limitations of traditional radar fault diagnosis system. The research results show that this method can not only diagnose radar faults remotely, but also improve the accuracy of remote radar fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Experimental study on vehicle extraction based on wv-2 image data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Real-time dynamic traffic information is an important basic information source for traffic monitoring and management. In view of the limitations of existing ground traffic detection equipment, people hope to be able to obtain a larger range of real-time dynamic traffic flow data with higher application value to monitor road traffic conditions far from the target. In this paper, features of wv-2 image data are analyzed. Firstly, gray scale transformation, filtering and mathematical morphology are used to preprocess the remote sensing image. Then, edge detection is used to extract the road and limit the area for vehicle identification. Then the method of double threshold and support vector machine is used to identify the vehicles on the road. Finally, the accuracy of the recognition results is analyzed. In the experimental results, the accuracy of the recognition using the double threshold method is 82.7%, and that of the support vector machine method is 95.2%. The latter has a better recognition rate.

articleTitle: Research on Static Software Defect Prediction Algorithm Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The static page processing software is easily disturbed by code defects, which causes the static page processing software to be paralyzed, thus making the accuracy of the static page processing poor. In order to improve the automatic prediction capability of the static page processing software, a code defect prediction technology for the static page processing software based on big data fusion and defect feature location technology algorithm is proposed, and the syntax running state characteristics of the operation and maintenance control management layer and software source code of the static page processing software are analyzed and tested. Using polymorphic software to drive the control program to carry out fault feature monitoring and information fusion of the page static processing software, carrying out polymorphic factor fusion and state feature analysis on the large data of defect fault feature distribution in the pseudo code of the software control program, combining Boehm model and ISO/IEC 9126 model to realize fault feature point location and defect active prediction of the page static processing software, According to the logicality of functions, codes and state variables of the page static processing software, the method of software running program continuity and similarity feature detection is adopted to realize the self-adaptive defect prediction and positioning of the page static processing software, and the global convergence control in defect prediction of the page static processing software is carried out by combining the big data fusion and defect feature positioning algorithm. The simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of page static processing software defects using this method is higher, the localization of defect codes is better, and the reliable operation capability of page static processing software is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-feature Extraction Method in EEG Signal of Motor Imagination
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The feature extraction of EEG signals of motor imaging is a very important step in the brain-computer interface system. We usually use the event-related synchronization/desynchronization (ERS/ERD) phenomenon of EEG signals, and use common motor imagination EEG signal’s feature extraction processing algorithms, including Common Spatial Pattern (CSP), Power Spectral Density (PSD), Autoregressive model (AR), Discrete Wavelet Transform DWT) method and other methods to extract features of EEG signals. This paper expounds the basic principle of the algorithm, and finally uses the support vector machine (SVM) to classify the left-hand and right-hand motor imagery patterns after processing the four methods. Comparative experiments show that the feature extraction method of multi-feature fusion better represents EEG features, and a better classification effect can be achieved by using SUM classification. This study can meet the requirements of BCI for high recognition rate.

articleTitle: Construction quality management method of green building engineering structure based on BIM model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The traditional construction structure construction quality management method ignores the mutual influence of various factors, divides the construction period into relatively independent links, and conducts quality management separately, resulting in poor management effectiveness of the traditional management method. In order to solve the above problems and improve the feasibility of the quality management method, the green construction engineering structure quality management method based on the BIM model is studied. Analyze the factors that affect the construction quality in the green building construction project, and determine the correlation between the factors. Use the BIM model to improve the three-dimensional spatial information of the building, and combine the PDCA quality management system to achieve the management of the construction quality of the project. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional construction quality management method, the quality management method based on BIM model is more feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Fast spectral clustering analysis of spatio-temporal data sets considering grouped progressive iterative approximation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of calculating the similarity between samples based on the Euclidean distance of attribute weighting of the grouping progressive iterative approximation algorithm, calculating the weight of each attribute of the sample; then, calculating the similarity between samples The matrix is applied to the spectral clustering method of sparse t-nearest neighbors and Nyström matrix low rank approximation; finally, it is verified on multiple data sets. The experimental results show that the method clusters on some data sets. The accuracy is higher than the original spectral clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: A new anti-collision algorithm based on RFID
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper first introduces some basic concepts of radio frequency identification(RFID), then introduces the RFID collision problem and the current popular anti-collision algorithm. Traditional anti-collision algorithms include ALOHA based anti-collision algorithm and binary tree based anti-collision algorithm. This paper mainly introduces ALOHA algorithm, slot ALOHA algorithm and dynamic frame slot ALOHA algorithm, compares the throughput parameters of each algorithm through calculation, and on this basis, proposes an improved dynamic frame slot ALOHA algorithm. This algorithm can achieve higher system utilization by dynamically changing the window size.

articleTitle: Short term prediction of traffic flow based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In recent years, the problem of urban traffic congestion has become increasingly serious. Urban rail transit is an important means to alleviate the urbanization problems such as traffic congestion and environmental pollution in the process of rapid urban development. Therefore, the short-term passenger flow prediction of urban rail transit system has become an important research direction of the current urban rail transit system. In this paper, wavelet de-noising method is used to process the original passenger flow data, and the processed data is input to the LSTM model based on the new neuron structure to learn and train the passenger flow data. Compared with the traditional k-nearest neighbor algorithm and the standard LSTM model. The prediction results show that compared with k-nearest neighbor algorithm and standard LSTM model, the accuracy of this method is improved.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of General Multi-nodes Weapon System Collaborative Simulation Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: According to the operational requirements of a typical weapon system, based on the physical model, functional model and probability model, the general multi-nodes simulation architecture of the weapon system is designed, the workflow of the simulation system is analyzed, the model implementation technology of the key simulation objects is described, and the functional simulation and performance simulation are built. The simulation platform provides the key support for the research of combat application, combat demand analysis and weapon technical scheme demonstration of the weapon system.

articleTitle: Design of Alarm System Based on Three-dimensional Audio Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: There is intensive information to display in the aero cockpit, so it is easy to lose observation signal by vision observation, which leads to disadvantageous effects on the flight control. According to human hearing characteristics, this paper analyzes a model of alerting system on the plane by using the virtual auditory display technology. Furthermore, it solves the key methods such as how to product and interpolate the head-related transfer function (HRTF) data, how to simulate the moving sound source’s distance and Doppler shift, and how to smooth transition of the sound signals. Simulation results show that the method provides the spatial audio image of the moving object, which can bring on a fast attention from the pilot who will dispose in time, and can become a new measure to improve the flight control.

articleTitle: Research on the application of an improved deep convolutional neural network in image recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the classic convolutional neural network with fewer convolutional layers, fixed convolution kernel size, and fewer features extracted, this paper proposes an improved deep convolutional neural network model, which different convolution kernels can be assigned to perform convolution operations according to the different amount of information in the image area, so it can better extract the effective information of the image and is more suitable for the recognition of complex images. Experiment shows that a higher recognition rate can be obtained.

articleTitle: Game theory Power control algorithm based on network connectivity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Power control plays an important role in reducing interference and conflict between Wireless Body Area Networks (WBAN). The goal of power control is to send the collected data with as small and appropriate transmission power as possible, which largely depends on the network type or different application scenarios. In this paper, a utility function based on network connectivity is established based on the basic principle of non-cooperative game theory. The algorithm considers the cost function based on SINR and proves the existence and uniqueness of Nash equilibrium solution.The algorithm proves that the Nash equilibrium solution exists and is unique through the analysis of the utility function.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-objective Optimal Control of Train Operation Based on EOL-NSGA-III Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the functional demands of the automatic train operation (ATO) system of urban rail transit, under the conditions of train operation safety, speed limit and train dynamics performance constraints, the multi-objective optimization model for the train operation is built with low energy consumption, stopping accuracy, punctuality and passenger comfort as control objectives. Under the MATLAB environment, first comparing the Pareto optimal solution of NSGA-III algorithm with Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III based on Elite opposition-based Learn (EOL- NSGA-III) algorithm, then based on the Beijing Yizhuang Line interval route data, the EOL-NSGA-III algorithm is applied to solve the multi-objective optimization model. The simulation results confirm the feasibility of the EOL-NSGA-III algorithm and the effectiveness of the multi-objective optimization model, thereby designing an efficient multi-objective operation of urban rail transit trains control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Static Routing and Wavelength Assignment Method Based on K-SP Alternative Routing and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the upper layer applications of 5G technology and Internet of Things in the future require low blocking rates for optical network service connections, this paper proposes a static wavelength routing assignment method based on improved K shortest path and genetic algorithm. Based on the idea of adding alternative supplementary path to each link of shortest path, a new and improved method of K shortest path is proposed. On this basis, a static routing and wavelength allocation method based on genetic algorithm is proposed to realize the optimal resource allocation of static traffic flow connection establishment request set. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can solve the static routing and wavelength assignment problem well.

articleTitle: An Obstacle recognition algorithm Based on Modified SSD
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the traditional target detection algorithm in the process of obstacle recognition, such as slow speed, low precision and easy to be affected by complex background. This paper proposes an obstacle recognition method based on improved SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector). Firstly, the network structure is optimized. Soft-NMS(softening non-maximum suppression) is used to obtain anchor boxes, providing better initial values for bounding box's prediction. SPP(spatial pyramid pooling) method is used to keep the image scale unchanged and reduce the overfitting. At the same time, batch processing normalization BatchNorm is used to randomly initialize the training model to obtain a stable and predictable gradient, which can stabilize the detector with random initialization training while maintaining good performance independent of the network architecture. Finally, four kinds of obstacles collected in the natural background were identified. The test results showed that the recognition speed of obstacles was the fastest based on the improved SSD, and the average recognition accuracy mAP could reach 79.95%, which was 5.35% higher than that of ssd-300. The SSD method proposed in this paper can effectively detect and recognize obstacles.

articleTitle: Prediction of emergency supplies based on improved Case-based reasoning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of old cases on prediction accuracy in traditional case-based reasoning (CBR), an improved case-based reasoning (CBR) method for emergency materials forecasting is proposed. The method adapts to the dependence of emergency events on social development by weakening the weight of old cases. Firstly, the coefficient of variation method is used to calculate the weight coefficient between case attributes. Secondly, the consumption strategy is used to reduce the weight of the old cases, and then the similarity between the cases is calculated to retrieve the best source case matching the target case. Finally, the simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of the improved method is proved to be better than that of the traditional method. Therefore, this method has a certain reference value for the prediction of emergency rescue materials.

articleTitle: Fault location of power cable based on Wheatstone digital bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The accuracy of fault location of power cables is an important parameter index for evaluating power supply repair teams. However, in view of the problems that the wave reflection method is difficult to identify the reflected wave head in the power cable insulation fault location, there are specific restrictions on the length of the cable, and the requirement for professional experience is high. A method does not need to analyze the pulse waveform to locate the location of the fault point. It has the advantages of high automation and no need for manual intervention. Statistical test results show that the new fault location method can adapt to different power cable faults, and the fault location accuracy rate can reach within ± 20 ‰, which is better than the wave reflection method ± 25 ‰ fault location accuracy.

articleTitle: Design on Message Generation of the TCC Balise Based on FFFIS Optimize Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of balise coding, better simulation line data message,a new encoding algorithm based on FFFIS is proposed.This method takes the balise message generation sub-module of the train control center system as the research object,and optimizes FFFIS coding algorithm through data scrambling bit, alphabet condition check, shaping constraint condition check.The optimized coding algorithm focuses on improving the scrambling bit, reducing the generation of invalid messages, checking alphabet conditions and shaping constraints in each link of the coding, reducing the possibility that user messages are invalid after coding.This method uses vs2013 as the software development platform, and verifies the correctness and practicability of the message generated by the optimized coding algorithm.On the basis of the above,the optimized encoding time is nearly 10ms faster than the original.Personnel and students can complete the application training of balise message preparation on the developed simulation platform.The research results are applied to the train control simulation training platform,and the actual application effect is good.

articleTitle: Big data clustering considering chaotic correlation dimension feature extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The big traditional feature extraction method is not suitable for big data feature extraction, and the extraction efficiency is low; therefore, a new efficient extraction method of big data key features based on chaotic correlation dimension feature extraction is proposed. The feature set is evaluated by the local features of the sample, and the key features of big data are selected. Therefore, a big data clustering algorithm based on chaotic correlation feature extraction is proposed. The shortcomings of traditional methods are analyzed, and a multi-dimensional state space vector and chaotic trajectory are established by reconstructing the phase space, so that many geometric feature quantities in the original system remain unchanged, which provides an effective basis for analyzing the chaotic characteristics of the original system. The false nearest neighbor algorithm is used to select the best embedding dimension with the time delay indicated by the abscissa when the average mutual information amount is taken as the first minimum value taken as the optimal time delay for reconstructing the phase space. The feature quantity of the extracted correlation dimension is used as the chaotic feature quantity of big data clustering, and the big data is clustered according to the extracted chaotic correlation dimension feature.

articleTitle: Voltage control of renewable-penetrated distribution network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The issue needs to be solved in this article is optimising voltage control of renewable-penetrated distributed network. The IEEE-33 system will be analysed in the article. The system includes many units, which are renewable energy, capacitor banks and diesel engine. The approach adopted in this paper is simulation in a fitness function by Matlab. Data management is the first step. It includes transfer active power, transfer reactive power and PV penetration. Next is model decision. Then, Genetic Algorithm is the chosen optimization method. The optimal result is illustrated at the end of this research.

articleTitle: Communication network node fault recovery strategy under network function virtualization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the output stability of communication network nodes, a fault recovery strategy of communication network nodes based on channel equalization scheduling under the virtualization of network functions is proposed. The channel model of wireless communication network under the condition of virtual network function is established, and the communication channel equalization is designed by Porter interval equalization scheduling method, Function virtualization, the phase shift of output channel of each node is obtained, and the impulse response of analog channel under the condition of network function virtualization is obtained. The simulation results show that this method has good adaptability to the fault recovery of communication network nodes, reduces the output error rate of communication network, and improves the transmission fidelity of communication network nodes.

articleTitle: A New Technique Research on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Classification is a basic problem in the field of data mining. It is one of the key steps that intelligent systems take when extracting meaningful information from complex and massive data. This paper introduces a new classification approach based on the theory of human vision from the perspective of bionics. The experimental results show that the new algorithm is efficient for the classification.

articleTitle: Sustainable Development in E-commerce Logistics for Remote Areas: A Cooperation Pricing Game Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: E-commerce logistics delivery for remote areas faces a big challenge in terms of high cost and low quality of service. This paper mainly focuses on the last mile delivery to remote areas. To achieve the multi-objective of lower cost and higher quality of service, a novel cooperation pricing game mode with Bertrand among the third-party logistics companies and local logistics companies has been proposed. After the introduction of the objective functions of logistics cost and quality of service, a set of cooperation pricing game models have been proposed, that can be carried out with different roles. Then, the pricing game model has been simulated in the virtual market. The data is assumed to be based on the Huangjiatun Village in Baishan City. Studying and solving this issue, which is good for the development of E-commerce logistics delivery for remote areas.

articleTitle: Health Evaluation Method of Power Information System Based on DEA-CCR
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the current situation that the power information system is becoming larger and larger and the operation and maintenance is more and more complex, this paper proposes an objective evaluation method of power information system index based on DEA-CCR. Apriori association rule algorithm is used to mine the association relationship between log information, and then select the important association rules that can express the health of power information system. Combined with the extracted association rules, using DEA-CCR evaluation model to get the comprehensive efficiency quantitative index of each decision-making unit, and then according to the extracted index, to evaluate the health of the system. Finall•y, an example is analyzed based on the log data of the host computer of the marketing system of a power company. The results show that the method in this paper is effective and objective, and has strong application value.

articleTitle: Robust Cooperative Primary User Localization in Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Localization of primary user (PU) is a challenging problem in cognitive radio network, there are two reasons for this difficulty, first, NLOS propagation in complex wireless communication environment will cause errors in ranging data, second, PUs and secondary users (SUs) cannot communicate directly. In this paper, we propose a robust primary user localization method, which consists of two steps, in the first step, SUs perform relative localization based on ranging, the second step is that the cooperative method based on received signal strength difference (RSSD) is used to determine the location of the PUs. The proposed method has less computational burden and is suitable for mobile wireless sensor network (WSN) nodes with limited power, in addition, it doesn't rely on additional positioning equipment such as satellite and Wi-Fi, and can be deployed in indoor and underground mine environments. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by numerical simulations, when there are outliers in the ranging data, our method can effectively realize the localization of SUs, and then determine the location of PU through least square method.

articleTitle: Research on the whole process intelligent management method of building construction based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor effect and long time-consuming of current intelligent management of building construction, an intelligent management method of the whole process of building construction based on BIM Technology is proposed. Lean the construction management mode, construct the three-dimensional virtual model of the construction project, optimize the intelligent management process of the whole construction process, and improve the intelligent management method of the whole construction process. Finally, the experiment proves that the BIM based intelligent management method in the whole process of building construction has a good effect in the practical application process, which can effectively solve the problem of long-time intelligent management in the whole process of building construction and fully meet the research requirements.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Transmission Policy of the Delay Insensitive Service: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the fast increasing of mobile devices and energy consumption, energy efficiency became a popular topic in recently. Fortunately, the emergence of various communication services and development of the reinforcement learning provided a new chance to increase the energy efficiency. In this paper, we analyze the delay insensitive service. And, the optimal problem of the energy efficiency is also formulated under the perfect channel states information (CSI) and statistical CSI assumptions, respectively. Furthermore, in order to overcome the limited of partial CSI, we proposed an energy efficient transmission policy based on the reinforcement learning. Numerical results show that the performance of the proposed policy is obvious better than the performance of statistical CSI and approaches to the performance of perfect CSI effectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of ShenTong Database Comparison Tool based on ODBC under Kylin Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: At present, there is no effective ShenTong database comparison software under the domestic Kylin operating system platform. The database comparison is mainly performed manually, which may cause heavy workload and high error rate. This article mainly studies the ShenTong database content comparison method based on Unix ODBC interface under the Kylin operating system platform, designs a software-based comparison method using ODBC driver, and implements the ShenTong database comparison software by executing SQL scripts or statements, which can compare two database instances, show the difference of tables and records, edit and synchronize the instances. At present, the software has been successfully applied to the maritime tracking and control software system, which greatly improved the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Train to Train Communication Resource Allocation Algorithm in Tunnel Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: To tackle the interference caused by sharing train to ground communication resources in train to train communication, we analyze the characteristics of the wireless environment of the tunnel, and adopt a method of improved weight bipartite graph matching and optimized power control to maximize the total throughput. The simulation results show that compared with macro cell base station under the ground environment, train to train communication quality under tunnel environment is better due to uniform signal strength coverage. This algorithm can still allocate channel and power more reasonably, which not only maximizes the total throughput but also greatly reduces the transmission power of train to train communication and train to ground communication.

articleTitle: Research on analysis and design of cloud ERP based on blockchain technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Cloud ERP systems are the ultimate aspiration of the business community as they provide collaboration with partners, external applications and information systems. However, Cloud ERP solutions still have issue on the data security, data transparency, and trust. Due to these problems, a radical change is required within Cloud ERP framework to enhance Cloud ERP infrastructural and functionality. The goal of this research is to merge cloud ERP and Blockchain benefits together to improve the Data Security, Transaction Traceability, Transparency, Data Ownership, Encryption and Trust through a proposed framework. For this purpose, we firstly analyze the prominent issues in current ERP systems through a comprehensive comparison between cloud ERP before and after moving to blockchain environment. Secondly, we propose a generic framework for Cloud ERP systems based on Blockchain. The proposed framework follows the Distributed Ledger Techniques in blockchain. Finally, the feasibility and efficiency of the proposed framework is tested through the study of the Supply Chain Management Module.

articleTitle: A Big Data Framework for Short-Term Load Forecasting Using Heterogenous Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to forecast Short-Term Load Forecast (STLF) for individual electric customers and then intelligently and flexibly utilize renewable energy, a Big Data framework is proposed that collects the data from smart meters and weather forecasting, pre-processes and loads it into a NoSQL database that is capable to store and further process large volumes of heterogeneous data. Then, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network is designed and implemented to determine the load profiles and forecast the electricity consumption for residential community for the next 24 hours. The proposed framework is tested with a publicly available smart meter dataset of a residential community, of which LSTM’s performance is compared with two benchmark algorithms in terms of Root Mean Square Errors (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Errors (MAPE).

articleTitle: A mathematical method for quantitative analysis of information acquisition efficiency based on DIT
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of how to evaluate the availability of information system quantitatively, a new mathematical calculation method based on Distance of Information-state Transition (DIT) is studied. In the paper the definition and calculation method of DIT are introduced, and two methods are recommended to reduce the DIT: one is to optimize the information state transfer structure, and the other is to improve users' information literacy. The research of DIT theory is helpful to improve the efficiency of users to obtain information and support users to make quick decisions with useful information.

articleTitle: Research on Microservice Application Testing Based on Mock Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems existing in the use of the micro-service application system and improve the work efficiency of the micro-service application system, this paper proposes a novel construction method of the micro-service application system based on Mock technology. The construction method uses mock technology, and analyses and studies mock technology and stub technology. In addition, the construction method also deeply analyzes the requirements of unit test integration test, and then formulates a test scheme that meets the requirements of micro-service application system. Based on this, the construction method also studies and develops supporting test tools for the developed test scheme, and determines the deployment mode of test tools. The results of this study show that this construction method can better solve the problems existing in the use of the current micro-service application system, and can fundamentally improve the accuracy of testing the micro-service application system.

articleTitle: Fault location of small current grounding system based on transient recorded wave data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The steady-state characteristics of the small current grounding system are not obvious, which leads to the low accuracy of the fault location results. Simplify the small current grounding system, analyze the transient recording data, and study the transient distribution characteristics of each component in case of fault. After fault line selection by wavelet analysis, fault location is realized by genetic algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed location method has high reliability, and the average location accuracy of the proposed method in branch line is nearly 10 times higher than that of other methods.

articleTitle: Research On Security Warning Model Of Intelligent Optical Cable Based On YOLOv3-tiny
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to ensure the unbolcked communication of optical cable lines need to be regularly inspected.Most of the existing UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) patrol systems work by collecting images from the aircraft and sending them back to the ground station for processing.It will take a long time and may be affected by the wireless channel, which makes it impossible to stop and intervene in time. This paper proposes an intelligent security warning system for optical cable line based on YOLOv3-tiny.By enlarging the pre-processed images of engineering vehicles, the data set is expanded and the generalization ability of the model is improved. The target box of the data set is reset by k-means clustering algorithm, which improves the parameter performance of YOLOv3-tiny. Finally, the model system was tested on the Nvidia jetson tx2 platform, and the results showed that the system could quickly carry out real-time detection of construction vehicles, with the Mean Average Precision (mAP) up to 0.33 and the detection speed up to 24fps.

articleTitle: Virtual Simulation Experiment of Singing Throat Function and Voice Part Determination
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and economic performance of voice part determination, this paper proposes a method of voice part determination based on virtual simulation technology. The three-dimensional rotation and simulation model of the whole structure of the singing part are established to realize the dynamic simulation of the coordination of each cavity. The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the method, and the virtual experiment of determining the function and part of singing throat can perfectly explain the aesthetic thoughts from the aspects of "formation", "form", "performance" and "aesthetic feeling" of the vocal cavity.

articleTitle: Analysis of the technical system and construction path of smart logistics
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems existing in the current intelligent logistics system in China, such as imperfect system, backward infrastructure, lack of talents and so on, this paper puts forward a novel construction method of intelligent logistics technology system and construction system based on artificial intelligence system. The construction method combines artificial intelligence system, based on Internet platform, and combines a variety of high and new technologies, such as big data technology, computer technology, cloud computing technology and so on. At the same time, the construction method promotes the development of China's intelligent logistics technology system from many aspects, such as strengthening policy support, speeding up the construction of data standardization, improving the terminal service system, promoting personnel training and so on. The research results show that the construction method can effectively alleviate the problems existing in the current intelligent logistics system of our country, and improve the intelligent level of the logistics system of our country, which also provides an important driving force for the economic development of our country.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Seismocardiogram Unperceivable Detection and Real-time Display System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As the most important organ of human circulatory system, the importance of heart is self-evident. At present, electrocardiogram (ECG) detection is widely used in clinic, but it is not conducive to long-term and real-time detection, which is easy to cause burden to patients and may miss the best treatment period. In this paper, a Insentience detection system based on the Seismocardiogram (SCG) signal is designed. The mechanical movement of the heart is measured by the pressure sensor under the object in close contact with the tester. The waveform and the related parameters of detected SCG signal are displayed on portable display device in real time. Experimental results conducted in the real environments shows that by comparing with synchronous extraction of ECG signal, the system can detect the SCG signal real-time and display the signal.

articleTitle: Design of panoramic display system of interior design works based on VR technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the display effect of interior design works, this paper designs a panoramic display system of interior design works based on VR technology. This paper analyzes the requirements of mobile terminal for VR panoramic display system, makes a simple division of system function modules, and designs the data flow between each function module. Then the modules of the system are designed in detail, including model simplification algorithm module, model loading module and VR engine module. The experimental results show that the system designed in this paper can improve the clarity of the interior landscape display, and can achieve a full range of clear display of interior design works, fully meet the research requirements.

articleTitle: Structural description model for vehicle feature recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Precise vehicle recognition has long been neglected compared with face recognition, meanwhile, benefiting from the development of neural networks, as same as face recognition, structural vehicle feature recognition is currently feasible. In this paper, we use a CNN-based cascaded multi-task framework for vehicle detection and alignment, then we trained a backbone CNN which can learn a mapping from vehicle image to a Euclidean space. Therefore, task of vehicle recognition can be solved as face recognition. Besides, different vehicles have different attributes compared with faces, we enriched the largest open source vehicle recognition dataset VehicleID with color and direction while the branch-CNN is employed to learn multiple features from different branches, outputs. Finally, structural vehicle features can be transformed from image to text which enhances the data expression ability.

articleTitle: Design of Monitoring Software for Automatic Spraying of Pavement of Road Ice-and-Snow Melting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the hazards of ice and snow disasters as well as the principle of the formation of bridge deck ice. JBoss is used as the application server, also MySQL is used as the database server to design and implement the monitoring software for the automatic spraying of road ice and snow melting, which provides a visual operation interface for the monitoring personnel. It can monitor the pavement conditions of high-risk sections in real time, providing a basis for decision-making and improving the maintenance efficiency.

articleTitle: Key Technology and Application of Virtual Ultrasonic Instrument Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Based on the graphic programming language LABVIEW, the virtual ultrasonic testing instrument was designed in this paper, and the key technologies of the instrument design and testing application, such as the determination of key parameters, the calling of dynamic link library, the Wavelet de-noising, etc. were introduced. The simulated defects of Φ0.4 mm hole in an engine blade can be detected by using surface wave. The test shows the effectiveness of the virtual ultrasonic instrument design and the key technology.

articleTitle: Development of wheel hub motor brake recovery control test bench
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the electric vehicle driven by hub motor, a test bench was designed and developed in order to study the brake recovery of the electric vehicle driven by hub. It can provide experimental basis for the use of the hub-driven electric vehicle. The test bench adopts modular design, and many other test modules can be added on the basis of the mechanical part of the bench. For some major electric vehicle tests, the designed bench can well realize simulation and experiment.The test bench is equipped with road resistance simulation, weight simulation, lateral force simulation, other test functions and braking energy recovery, etc. It is a test bench for the comprehensive performance of electric vehicle driven by hub motor. The electric wheel module integrates various functions of vehicle driving, steering and braking. The maximum limit of the platform is simulated under real working conditions. Therefore, it can test these performances well. The test bench uses a hybrid battery and ultracapacitor, that is, a battery-ultracapacitor hybrid storage unit, to give play to the advantages of large specific energy of the battery and large specific power of the ultracapacitor. It can satisfy the dual requirements of the electric vehicle’s comparative energy and specific power and extend the driving range to the maximum extent, which provided a convenient for the research of wheel drive EV.

articleTitle: Research on the Capability Demand of intelligent Command Information System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper aims at the problems existing in the command information system, Based on the command information system development. Draw lessons from the Internet cloud architecture, artificial intelligence, big data, Internet and other new technology into the command information system, enable intelligence, adaptability, flexibility and toughness of the command information system play a combat effectiveness, building "the Internet cloud brain" as the core, service as the granularity, data as the center, with artificial intelligence as the gripper hierarchical intelligent command information system architecture., and the ability of the command information system based on DODAF2.0 classification, ability, ability to depend on the ability to view are expounded.

articleTitle: Data Encryption of Big Data Redundancy Elimination Algorithm Combining Bloom Filter Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of various businesses, data have presented explosive growth. The previous data redundancy elimination algorithm had high storage consumption, prolonged time consumption, and unsatisfactory detection effect of repetition rate. This paper introduced the Bloom filter data structure to reduce the dimension of big data and proposed a new data redundancy elimination algorithm. Firstly, the complete file detection algorithm is used in this algorithm to test and match the data. For the data blocks passing the test, the CDC block detection algorithm is used for further testing and matching. The cosine similarity equation and Hamming distance value are used to calculate the data similarity, complete the final redundancy elimination of data, and perform data encryption on this basis equation. The simulation experiment results suggest that the data redundancy elimination algorithm proposed in this paper has excellent comprehensive performance, which has not only ensured the detection accuracy of data repetition rate but also improved the data detection speed, while reducing the storage overhead and protecting the data security at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-jamming control of Hexapod Robot Based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: As a kind of equipment widely used in industrial aerospace, disaster detection and other fields, the technology related to hexapod robot has become mature, but from the perspective of motion control, especially for the problem of poor stability and anti-interference ability caused by traditional PID controller, it has not been well solved. In this paper, based on the auto disturbance rejection control(ADRC) technology, the control scheme of hexapod robot is improved. First, a reasonable assumption is introduced to simplify the model, and Newton mechanics analysis method is used to model the system. Then the simulation model is established in MATLAB, and the simulation test is carried out. Compared with the traditional PID, the transition process of ADRC based attitude balance control and position control method only takes about 4 seconds, with short time and fast response speed, which improves its anti-interference and variable load response ability, thus verifying the effectiveness of the new control method.

articleTitle: An Optical Transmission Network Simulation System Based on Hardware Functions Software Implementation Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to meet the higher requirements of 5G and iot technologies on the operation, maintenance, management and control of optical communication transmission network in the future, low-cost optical transmission network simulation system is urgently needed to realize the rapid improvement of maintenance staff's operation and maintenance ability.
