In response to this problem, this paper adopts a hardware functions software implementation method, under the guidance of design ideas such as versatility, uniformity, standardization, authenticity and openness, based on a combination of software and hardware architecture, to develop a low-cost simulation network management system and simulation optical transmission network with complete functions and strong expandability. It can provide support for the intelligent management, application, teaching and training of optical transmission network equipment.

articleTitle: Development of Salt Lake Hydrographic Acquisition System based on Beidou Short Message Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper is funded by the 2017 National Natural Science Foundation of China (NSFC) project "Research on Integrated Salt Lake Monitoring and Flood Early Warning System Based on Multi-source Information Fusion Theory" (Grant No. 41671521), and introduces the development of a salt lake hydrological acquisition system based on Beidou satellite short message communication for areas with poor or no GPRS signal. The key technologies such as low-power power control using KIS-3R33S module in the data acquisition system consisting of STC15W4K32S4 microcontroller, system "watchdog" function, YEH-KJ2X ultrasonic radar range sensor and its improvement, and DS18B20 digital temperature sensor were introduced in detail. The structure of the telemetry system using the Beidou II short message communication module and the core code of the network status detection in the data receiving and sending of the Beidou module were also introduced in detail. The system has been operating normally for 18 months at the site of a salt lake in western Haixi State, Qinghai Province, with a loss rate of less than 1 per cent of telemetry data. The study found that the networking efficiency of the Beidou module in the vast waters is low, and the improved networking efficiency has improved to some extent, but it is difficult to meet the real-time telemetry requirements.

articleTitle: IPv6 Based Intelligent Monitoring System for industrial instruments
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the limitations and drawbacks of the current industrial instrument intelligent monitoring system, and to improve the work efficiency of the industrial instrument intelligent monitoring system, this paper proposes a construction method of the industrial instrument intelligent monitoring system based on IPv6. This construction method breaks the traditional industrial production mode, which is based on the Internet platform. It is different from the traditional IPv4 network, and the IPv6 network can assign more addresses, thus making the network transmission faster and more stable. Based on this, the construction method can also collect the operation status data information of the instrument in real time, and then realize the storage, analysis and application of the data information. The research results show that this construction method can realize the function of remote real-time monitoring, and it can also improve the production efficiency of enterprises on the basis of reducing labor costs.

articleTitle: Intelligent Electromagnetic Warp Artillery Based On OpenMV Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of short range and low precision of the electromagnetic curved gun control system in the course of launching, this paper proposes a modern electromagnetic curved gun control system with strong launching kinetic energy designed by OpenMV technology. This method mainly takes visual processing as the recognition method, which can automatically run the preset pattern in a specific environment without human management, and can accomplish the higher goal expected to be achieved. The intelligent electromagnetic curved gun control system described in this paper is based on STM32103C8T6 SCM as the main controller, realizes controllable Angle through OpenMV recognition of color and distance, automatically searches the control device that identifies the target firing projectile, and can modify the mode and adjust parameters in OLED display screen at any time according to the change of operating environment. Finally, the system test parameters show that the control system has the advantages of easy control, high initial speed and low energy consumption, and successfully improves the practical problems of short range and low accuracy.

articleTitle: An Improved Fast Fuzzy Clustering Image Segmentation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Fuzzy C-means (FCM) clustering algorithm for image segmentation is simple, intuitive and easy to implement, However, there are some problems such as large amount of computation, slow computation speed and poor anti-noise ability. For this reason, this paper proposes an improved fast FCM algorithm (FFCM), This method firstly integrates spatial information into standard FCM algorithm, The image is mapped from pixel space to its gray histogram feature space, and fast clustering is realized. Then, on the basis of fast clustering, the neighborhood characteristics of pixels are fully utilized, and the classification of image pixels is divided according to the principle of maximum membership degree, and the membership degree function is improved to some extent. The experimental results show that the method can segment images quickly and effectively, and has good anti-noise capability.

articleTitle: Real-time prediction of W-band dynamic rain attenuation based on chaotic mapping particle swarm optimization BP neural network-ARIMA model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the low prediction accuracy, stability and real-time performance of ARIMA (1,1,5) rain attenuation model, which is commonly used to verify W-band Rain Attenuation Prediction model, this paper firstly improves the BP neural network model by using chaotic mapping and particle swarm optimization algorithm, and then combines the improved BP neural network with ARIMA (1,1,5) model to propose chaotic mapping particles. Group optimization BP neural network-autoregressive summation moving average rainfall decline prediction model. Then, the simulation results are compared with ARIMA (1,1,5) and ITU-R models respectively. The results show that the accuracy and stability of the model are better than ARIMA model, which shows that the model can be used for real-time prediction of W-band rain attenuation.

Author Keywords: Autoregressive Sum Moving Average Reference format

articleTitle: Research on an Algorithm for Wideband Acoustic Source Orientation Using Vector Sensor Array
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: A wideband noise target orientation algorithm based on vector sensor array is proposed. The algorithm decomposes the received data of vector sensor array into three independent array observation data. By constructing the orientation matrix of vector sensor array, it realizes the accurate estimation of the azimuth parameters of wideband noise source, and overcomes the problems of peak searching and parameter matching in the conventional direction estimation. Analyzing the noise signal radiated by the air target, the positioning accuracy of the algorithm under different SNR is studied. The results show that the algorithm can give the number of noise sources correctly and has high estimation accuracy. When the SNR is 5dB, the orientation error is less than 1.0°. Compared with the traditional acoustic pressure sensor positioning system, the positioning accuracy is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Study on dynamic fault tree based mechanical abnormal running state detection method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Because of the low sensitivity of the traditional method, the error of the detection result is large. In view of the above problems, the detection method of mechanical abnormal operation state based on dynamic fault tree is studied. The dynamic fault tree of mechanical operation state is established, and the dynamic fault tree is modularized, decomposed and quantitatively analyzed. The dynamic fault tree is input into the computer, and combined with the characteristics of mechanical fault signal, the detection of mechanical abnormal operation state is realized. The experimental results show that the proposed method has smaller detection error and higher sensitivity.

articleTitle: Color Image Segmentation Based on Wavelet Transform and Fuzzy Kernel Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: A color image segmentation algorithm combining multi-resolution of wavelet transform and fuzzy clustering is proposed. Firstly, the mean shift segmentation result is used to initialize the clustering center to speed up the convergence speed of clustering. At the same time, the kernel function is introduced into FCM to form fuzzy kernel clustering (KFCM) to obtain better clustering results. Then, using the multi-resolution characteristics of wavelet transform, the results of the previous layer are used for initialization of the next layer to realize image segmentation from coarse to fine, thus reducing the complexity and computation of segmentation. The experimental results show that the algorithm has fast segmentation speed and is superior to the traditional FCM algorithm and mean shift algorithm in segmentation of natural color images.

articleTitle: External Interrupt Extension and Software Implementation of Multi-interrupt Priority for MCS-51 Single Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The series of MCS 51 Single Chip Microcomputer (SCM) only have two external interrupts and two interrupt priorities. This paper introduces three methods for the extension of external interrupts. It also specifies the program of each extension through the employment of software. This method can be applied to the system requiring several external interrupts and multi-level interrupt nestings.

articleTitle: Study on the conversion of multiple communication protocols between power quality improvement auxiliary devices
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the difficulties encountered in the current debugging of different equipment, to reduce the workload of different equipment debugging, and to improve the standardization of the interface and power quality, this paper proposes a construction method of multiple communication protocol conversion system between auxiliary devices to improve power quality. The construction method is based on the principle of embedded intelligent protocol converter, which can be compatible with a variety of common communication protocols on the market. Based on this, the construction method takes the power line carrier communication as the carrier, and takes the COAP-lot protocol as the conversion target protocol, which can provide two major functions for the power quality auxiliary equipment, namely, data exchange and plug and play. The research results show that the construction method can greatly reduce the debugging workload of different equipment, and break the limitations of traditional power quality improvement equipment.

articleTitle: Improvement of Dark Channel Defogging Algorithm Based on Duided Filtering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the dark channel prior defogging algorithm has the problems that the dark channel fails in large areas such as sky or white objects and the guided filtering algorithm is not completely defogging, a single image defogging improvement based on dark channel prior and guided filtering is proposed algorithm. First obtain the minimum image of each color channel of the foggy image and the rough estimate of the transmittance according to the dark channel theory, use the guide filter for the minimum image to obtain the guide image containing the edge information, and then use the guide filter again to optimize the initial transmittance. The problem of underestimation of the transmittance of the foggy sky area is to determine the range of the sky area and make certain adjustments to its transmittance, and use the quadtree search algorithm to obtain accurate atmospheric light values. Finally, the fog-free image is recovered through the atmospheric physical model, and the algorithm is compared with other defogging algorithms. The results show that the algorithm can effectively process foggy images containing sky areas, and the time complexity is low.

articleTitle: Fuzzy adaptive control method for multi unit series high power inverter
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: According to the characteristics of multi unit series high-power inverter, a fuzzy adaptive control method for high-power inverter is proposed. Firstly, the structure of multi unit series high-power inverter is optimized, and then a stability control algorithm of inverter power supply is designed. On this basis, a fuzzy adaptive control scheme based on discrete Fourier transform is designed. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional method, this method has lower control error, and the stability of multi unit series high-power inverter is good, which meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: The Application of Evaluation Factors Based on Bayesian Method in Reconstruction of Historical Events
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the evaluation of measurement information in reconstruction problems, taking the reconstruction of historical events as an example discusses the role of the weight and reaction rate of the information carrier in the process of oxidative decomposition under natural conditions in identifying the effect of the information carrier on the reconstruction of historical events. What’s more, the relationship between the lost information and the reconstruction accuracy is also presented in this paper. This paper uses the evaluation factor based on Bayesian method and information entropy to judge whether historical events can be reconstructed by existing measurement information. Finally, the paper demonstrates the the feasibility of the method by providing an example.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Fault state identification method of transmission line grounding resistance based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: When using the artificial method to monitor the state of the transmission line grounding resistance, there will be the problem that the test time is too long to monitor the fault point in time. This paper proposes the method of the transmission line grounding resistance monitoring and fault state identification based on neural network. Using neural network, the fault points in the line decomposition section are determined, and the ground resistance is monitored in real time on the basis of the fault points. Analysis of the experimental results shows that the monitoring errors of the method in this paper are less than 0.1Ω, while the monitoring errors of the three pole phase method and clamp meter method in the resistance results are more than 1Ω, and the monitoring errors of clamp meter method are even as high as 6Ω at one time. Therefore, through the experimental comparison, we can know that the method in this paper is accurate in monitoring the grounding state of transmission lines, and can be used for online monitoring of tower grounding state.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Interaction between Intracranial Pressure and Cerebral Blood Flow
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Numerical Simulation of the interaction between Intracranial Pressure (ICP) and Cerebral Blood Flow (CBF) based on physiology and hemodynamics is presented. The circulation of the cerebral blood and the circulation of the cerebrospinal fluid are considered in this model. The model includes the main biomechanical factors assumed to affect intracranial pressure, particularly cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) dynamics, intracranial compliance, and cerebral hemodynamics, which is in accordance with the fact. We can list some state equations on the basis of the model, which can be solved using MATLAB. Comparison between the experimental recordings and simulated intracranial pressure signals shows that they are consistent and there is a correlation between the intracranial pressure and the arterial pressure, proving the validity of the model. This paper provides an assistant method for clinic noninvasive monitoring intracranial pressure.

articleTitle: Using Motion Deblurring Algorithm to Improve Vehicle Recognition via DeblurGAN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to overcome the effect of motion blur on automatic vehicle detection, recognition and tracking in traditional vehicle identification field, we propose an algorithm via Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) for de-blurring motion blurred vehicle images. The algorithm uses Generator and Discriminator in GAN to game each other, making the resulting image closer to the target image. Based on the above, the two networks use the VGG19 network in the process of playing with each other, which makes the image de-motion blurring better, thus effectively improving the vehicle recognition rate. The algorithm is therefore significant for target detection systems in computer vision systems. From the final experimental evaluation, the images generated via this algorithm have greatly improved the recognition appearance, PSNR and SSIM, and the recognition rate of the vehicles can be increased by up to 34%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Residential Buildings Layout With Wind Environment Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Optimization of residential buildings layout while keep a suitable internal wind environment has become increasingly important in architecture layout designing. Therefore, our study carries out research from two perspectives of layout optimization and wind environment simulation, with the purpose of helping architects find suitable layouts in design process. Our method is consists of a genetic algorithm and a Fully Convolutional Network model (FCN), which can generate an optimal layout design plan while obey its internal wind environment constraints in a reasonable time. The result showed that FCN greatly improves the time efficiency of wind environment simulation with acceptable prediction error and the genetic algorithm has greatly improved the space distance between buildings comparing to the initial layouts.

articleTitle: Direction-Of-Arrival Estimation Based On Joint Sparse Recovery
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: For the problem of Direction-Of-Arrival (DOA) Estimation using sensor arrays, we present a DOA estimation algorithm, called Joint-Sparse DOA. Firstly, DOA estimation is cast as the joint-sparse recovery problem. Then, norm is approximated by arctan function to express joint sparsity and DOA estimation can be obtained by minimizing approximate norm. Finally, the minimization problem is solved by quasi-Newton method to estimate DOA. Simulation results show that our algorithm has some advantages over most existing methods: it needs a small number of snapshots to estimate DOA, while the number of sources need not be known a priori. Besides, it improves the probability of resolution, and it can also handle the correlated sources well.

articleTitle: Parametric adaptive VMD method and its applications on early fault diagnosis for rolling bearing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved parametric adaptive variational mode decomposition (VMD) method, in view of the problem with the traditional VMD method in defining parameters the mode number K and the penalty parameter α. First, taking fault impacts and periodicity into consideration, this paper adopts the Gini index and spectrum peak ratio (SPR) index as the basis to construct a weighted spectrum peak ratio (WSPR) index. After that, it takes the maximization of the WSPR index as the optimization objective, using the whale optimization algorithm (WOA) to find the optimal parameter combination for K and α, and avoids the disadvantages of subjective parameters selection. Finally, it follows the maximum WSPR principle to automatically select a sensitive intrinsic mode function (IMF) and extract fault characteristics via envelope demodulation analysis. The proposed method is verified through experimental signal. As shown by the results, this method can effectively extract weak characteristics of early fault signals and offer the accurate judgment of fault types.

articleTitle: A Cognitive Electronic Attack Evaluation Method Based on Behavior Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to improve the effectiveness of cognitive electronic attack, this paper proposes a novel method to evaluate the effectiveness of cognitive electronic attack based on behavior recognition. In the modern battlefield environment, the electronic attacker establishes the behavior observation space of the target and its collaborator, and obtains their behavior parameters. These behavior parameters are closely related to the effect of electronic attack. A trained neural network being used to identify and process the behaviors of the target and its collaborator, the evaluation value of the electronic attack effect obtained by this method can achieve much higher accuracy than the traditional method. The application of the evaluation results can provide the necessary information for the OODA loop attack strategy and speed up the OODA loop.

articleTitle: Power control strategy based on energy efficiency optimization in D2D network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of Device-to-Device (D2D) users sharing the spectrum resources of the cellular network, a power control strategy is proposed due to the problem of impaired energy efficiency of the D2D network caused by improper transmission power. With the goal of maximizing the energy efficiency of the D2D network, the D2D user transmission rate is combined with the terminal battery energy to establish a cooperative game model under the constraints of the interference threshold, the D2D user as a player dynamically adjusts the transmission power according to the mutual interference energy, at the same time introducing weighting factor structure of the utility function, the appropriate weighting factor is selected through simulation and the existence and uniqueness of the Nash equilibrium solution of the cooperative game model are proved. Finally, through repeated iterations, the optimal transmission power of the user when the energy efficiency of the D2D network is maximum is obtained. Simulation shows that the algorithm in this paper can effectively suppress interference, extend the battery life of D2D user terminals, and achieve higher network utility.

articleTitle: Research on Tracking Technology of Service Call Chain Based on Microservice Architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In recent years, With the continuous rise of microservice technology, microservice application systems are becoming more and more popular. There is a big difference in structure between microservice applications and traditional monolithic applications, the dependencies between microservices are also becoming more and more complex. At the same time, the tracking analysis technology and testing technology of the microservice application system are not highly developed. This paper studies the service tracking technology suitable for microservice architecture. By analyzing the principles of the microservice call chain and selecting the appropriate tracking technology, the technology of service call chain data generation, collection, storage and analysis can be realized. Finally, the service tracking technology under the microservice architecture is implemented.

articleTitle: Research on multi level aggregation of privacy preserving data in Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The traditional privacy protection data aggregation method is prone to errors in the process of aggregation, which affects the final clustering effect. Therefore, this paper proposes and designs a new multilevel aggregation method for privacy protection data in the Internet of Things. First integration of privacy protection data sharing dynamic elements and design specification, clustering based on this, complete the Internet privacy protection data extraction and processing, so as to realize data clustering for many times, and retain most of the features of the original data space, data privacy protection data obtained by multi-stage polymerization can be well preserved. Simulation results show that, compared with the traditional method, the aggregation error rate of this method is obviously lower, which ensures the security, efficiency and applicability of the privacy-protected data to a greater extent.

articleTitle: Research on detection method of micro cracks in mechanical welding based on Bayesian inference
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In view of the typical defects of the welding structure, the detection method of micro cracks in mechanical welding based on Bayesian inference is proposed. According to the micro crack detection signal of mechanical welding defects, combined with Bayesian inference, PCA and common classification algorithm, the micro crack features of mechanical welding are extracted. On the basis of this, denoise the micro crack detection signal and extract useful information. The processed signals are input into SVM classifier, and the penalty factor and RBF kernel function are optimized according to the process of simulating colony foraging. The global optimal value for crack detection is selected. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of the research method is high, which fully meets the research requirements.

articleTitle: Acquisition Technology for the Third Beidou Satellite Navigation Signal with Low Signal-to-Noise Ratio and High Dynamic
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of acquisition of the third generation Beidou satellite navigation signal with low SNR and high dynamic, a BOC (1,1) signal acquisition technology based on the non-coherent accumulation of BPSK-like PMF-FFT is proposed. The influence of carrier Doppler frequency offset and code Doppler on PN code acquisition is considered simultaneously in this algorithm, according to searching range for Doppler frequency offset, first-order Doppler frequency offset changing rate and code Doppler, the parameters of acquisition algorithm are determined, and the quantitative analysis results of detection value are given. The detection probability formula of the acquisition algorithm is derived, and its correctness is proved, Compared with the minimum carrier to noise ratio of Beidou system, the algorithm in this paper has a margin of 9.7db in the worst case. Finally, the scheme of carrier Doppler rate of change and code Doppler compensation for extremely low SNR and high dynamic signals is given.

articleTitle: Identity Authentication based on User Mouse Behavior
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: Improving the performance of identity authentication is a difficult issue due to the sparsity of feature space of user mouse behaviors, this paper investigates a new identity authentication method, which improves the sparse representation of user mouse behaviors from a new perspective. Firstly, the feature space of user mouse behaviors can be characterized from both the mouse's overall behavior features and mouse’s trajectory behavior features and also can be effectively reduced according to the validity of features. Secondly, we present a fusion method of multiple classifiers to solve the problem of over-fitting in a single classifier and improve the performance of mouse-behavior based continuous authentication. Finally, comparative experiments are conducted in order to further examine the effectiveness of the proposed method. These findings suggest that the fusion method of multiple classifiers based on Stacking outperforms the traditional single classification method in user mouse identity identification.

articleTitle: Macroeconomic policy analysis model based on Dynamic Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: With the development of economic globalization, the traditional empirical judgment and policy qualitative analysis can no longer meet the needs of policy makers. The current economic and trade policies are increasingly urgent to meet international standards. Therefore, this paper proposes and designs a macro-economic policy analysis model based on dynamic game theory. In the process of macroeconomic policy analysis, it is necessary to ensure that the decision-making tools conform to international standards. By understanding the non cooperative game of macroeconomic policy under complete symmetric impact and the cooperative game of monetary policy under completely asymmetric impact, the macroeconomic policy of dynamic game theory can be effectively realized Reasonable analysis.

articleTitle: Research on extraction method of flat gain characteristics of multi-channel radar antenna
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Virtual Reality and Intelligent Systems (ICVRIS)
abstract: The beam flatness gain of multichannel radar antenna is an important auxiliary characteristic in the process of target detection and recognition. Active multi-target jamming is a typical method to extract flat beam gain of multi-channel radar antenna. It affects the detection, tracking and recognition ability of phased array radar, and also affects the judgment of phased array radar on the status. In order to improve the detection ability and networking ability of phased array radar, this paper optimizes the extraction method of beam flattening gain characteristics of multi-channel radar antenna under the background of accurate main lobe interference, so as to ensure the normal operation of radar antenna device. Finally, the numerical simulation is carried out. Experimental results show that this method can effectively suppress active multi-target interference. This conclusion is of great significance to improve the detection ability of radar in complex electromagnetic environment.
